model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.name: int_bridge_opportunity_project
model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.description: This model takes the links from dvbridge_opportunity_project and enriches it from the Project and Opportunity datavault Business Concepts
model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.raw_code:
SELECT
    bc_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid as DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
    bc_opportunity.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
    dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_project_sid as DIM_PROJECT_SID,
    dvbridge_opportunity_project.PROJECT_BK,
    bc_project.primary_project_hierarchy,
    bc_opportunity.stage_bk,
    bc_opportunity.sow_value,
    bc_project.deal_value,
    -- If stage of CLOSED_WON, and we have a Workday project, use the Deal value
    -- Not all Opportunities (Ping Stax) have projects therefore h_project_sid will be null, so allow for this
    CASE
        WHEN bc_opportunity.stage_bk = 'CLOSED_WON' AND bc_project.h_project_sid IS NOT NULL 
            THEN bc_project.deal_value
        ELSE
            bc_opportunity.sow_value
    END AS opportunity_project_value
FROM
    -- Bridge is now the driving table for opportunity/project combinations.
    {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project') }}
        left join {{ ref('bc_opportunity') }}
            on dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_opportunity_sid = bc_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid
        left join {{ ref('bc_project') }}
            on dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_project_sid = bc_project.h_project_sid

model.cr_project.int_bundled_projects_ma.name: int_bundled_projects_mapping
model.cr_project.int_bundled_projects_ma.description: This model enriches Bundled revenue, a pre workday revenue source, with Workday compatable fields
model.cr_project.int_bundled_projects_ma.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
WITH 
    stg_opportunity_salesforce AS (
        SELECT
            project_bk,
            opportunity_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
            client_bk,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PROJECT_BK ORDER BY PROJECT_NAME) row_num
        FROM
            {{ ref('snapshot_salesforce_opportunity') }}
        WHERE
            dbt_valid_to is null
            and dbt_is_deleted = 'False'
        QUALIFY row_num = 1
        ),
    other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings as (
        -- de-duplicate rows
        SELECT
            distinct
            region, 
            cost_center_bk
        FROM
            {{ref('other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings')}}
        where old_region = 'PROFESSIONALSERVICES'
    )
SELECT
    bundled_projects.*,
    COALESCE(
        bc_client_current.client_bk, 
        stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_bk,
        '{{var("ghost_record")}}')                                          AS client_bk,
    IFNULL(
        stg_opportunity_salesforce.opportunity_bk,                       
        '{{var("ghost_record")}}')                                          AS opportunity_bk,
    IFNULL(stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_account_director_bk,           '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS client_account_director_bk,
    IFNULL(other_region_workday_region_mappings.region_bk,                  '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS region_bk,
    IFNULL(other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings.cost_center_bk,        '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS cost_center_bk,
    IFNULL(xero_workday_practice_mappings.practice_bk,                      '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS practice_bk,
    IFNULL(bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,   'RC_PS_TM') as REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
    IFNULL(bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.REVENUE_CATEGORY_NAME, 'Professional Services Revenue - Time & Materials') as REVENUE_CATEGORY_NAME
FROM
    {{ ref('stg_manual_bundled') }} as bundled_projects
    LEFT JOIN stg_opportunity_salesforce
        ON bundled_projects.project_bk = stg_opportunity_salesforce.PROJECT_BK
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('other_region_workday_region_mappings') }}
        on upper(bundled_projects.region) = upper(other_region_workday_region_mappings.region)
    LEFT JOIN other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.REGION) = UPPER(other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings.REGION)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('xero_workday_practice_mappings') }}
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.division) = UPPER(xero_workday_practice_mappings.division)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping') }}
         ON bundled_projects.project_bk LIKE CONCAT('%', bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.HARVEST_CODE_SUFFIX)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('bc_client_current') }}
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.CLIENT) = UPPER(bc_client_current.CLIENT_NAME)

model.cr_project.int_dv__project__activi.name: int_dv__project__activity_dates__source
model.cr_project.int_dv__project__activi.description:
This model takes the earliest and latest dates for Projects from most sources, and finds thae min/max of all sources.
    This will then be provided to sat_project_activity_dates
model.cr_project.int_dv__project__activi.raw_code:
with 
    journal_line_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            min(month_start_date)   as earliest_month,
            max(month_start_date)   as latest_month
        from
            {{ ref('stg_workday__journal_lines') }}
        where project_bk is not null
        group by project_bk
    ),
    stg_workday__project_resource_forecast as (
        select
            project_bk,
            date_trunc('MONTH', forecast_date)                                              as month_start_date

        from
            {{ ref('snapshot_project_resource_forecast_history') }}
        where project_bk is not null
    ),
    project_booking_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            min(month_start_date)   as earliest_month,
            max(month_start_date)   as latest_month
        from
            stg_workday__project_resource_forecast
        group by project_bk
    ),
    workday_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            start_date_month,
            end_date_month
        from
            {{ ref('stg_workday__projects') }}
    ),
    final as (
        select 
            workday_dates.project_bk,
            least(
                ifnull(journal_line_dates.earliest_month,    workday_dates.start_date_month),
                ifnull(project_booking_dates.earliest_month, workday_dates.start_date_month),
                workday_dates.start_date_month
            ) as ACTIVITY_START_MONTH,
            greatest(
                ifnull(journal_line_dates.latest_month,     workday_dates.end_date_month),
                ifnull(project_booking_dates.latest_month,  workday_dates.end_date_month),
                workday_dates.start_date_month
            ) as ACTIVITY_END_MONTH,
            'int_dv__project__activity_dates__source'    as record_source,
            to_timestamp_ltz(current_timestamp)          as load_date_time

        from
            workday_dates
            left join
                journal_line_dates
                    on workday_dates.project_bk = journal_line_dates.project_bk
            left join
                project_booking_dates
                    on workday_dates.project_bk = project_booking_dates.project_bk
    )
select
    *
from
    final

- `h_client_sid` — Hashed surrogate key for hub_client.
- `client_hashdiff` — Hashdiff for change detection in sat_client_workday.

model.cr_project.int_dv_journal__distinc.description: This model creates a layer to get the distinct Journal BKs from Workday
model.cr_project.int_dv_journal__distinc.raw_code:
with journal_line as (
    select distinct
        journal_bk,
        journal as journal_name
    from {{ ref('stg_workday__journal_lines') }}
),

journal_line_nofilter as (
    select distinct
        journal_bk,
        journal_name
    from {{ ref('stg_workday__project_revenue') }}
),

unioned as (
    select
        journal_bk,
        journal_name,
        'workday/journal_lines' as record_source,
        current_timestamp() as load_date_time
    from journal_line

    union all

    select
        journal_bk,
        journal_name,
        'workday/journal_lines_no_filter' as record_source,
        current_timestamp() as load_date_time
    from journal_line_nofilter
),

final as (
    select *
    from unioned
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by journal_bk
        order by
            load_date_time desc,
            record_source asc
    ) = 1
)

select
    journal_bk,
    journal_name,
    record_source,
    load_date_time
from final

model.cr_project.int_dv_project__xero__d.raw_code:
with
    -- XERO revenue union
    projects as (
        {{
            dbt_utils.union_relations(
                relations=[

                    ref('stg_xero__stax__bank_transactions'),
                    ref('stg_xero__stax__credit_notes'),
                    ref('stg_xero__stax__invoices') ,
                    ref('stg_xero__stax__manual_journals'),

                    ref('stg_xero__singapore__credit_notes'),
                    ref('stg_xero__singapore__invoices') ,
                    ref('stg_xero__singapore__manual_journals'),

                    ref('stg_xero__versent__credit_notes'),
                    ref('stg_xero__versent__invoices') ,
                    ref('stg_xero__versent__manual_journals'),
                    ref('stg_xero__versent__payments')
                ],
                include=[
                    "PROJECT_BK",
                    "RECORD_SOURCE"
                ]
            )
        }}
    ),
    distinct_projects as (
        select
            distinct
            upper(project_bk) as project_bk,
            max(record_source)      as record_source    -- Do this as the project_bk may be in multiple files from xero,
        from
            projects
        where
            project_bk is not null
        group by
            project_bk
    )
select
    *
from
    distinct_projects

model.cr_project.int_fact_employee_absen.description: This model creates a layer to get the Business Keys required to link to other Dimensions.
model.cr_project.int_fact_employee_absen.raw_code:
with
    bridge_employee_absence as (
        select
            employee_absence_bk,
            employee_bk,
            absence_type_bk,start_date,
            end_date,
            unit_of_time,
            unit_quantity,
            status,                 
            record_source
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_employee_absence') }}
    ),

    bc_employee as (
        select
            employee_bk,
            working_hours
        from 
            {{ref('bc_employee_current')}}
    ),
    dates as (
        select
            date_bk
        from
            {{ref('ref_calendar_dates')}}
    ),    
    --create record for each day of the absence period
    employee_absence_date_cross_apply as (
        select
            dates.date_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.unit_of_time,
            bridge_employee_absence.unit_quantity,
            bridge_employee_absence.status,                 
            bridge_employee_absence.record_source
        from bridge_employee_absence
        join dates
            on dates.date_bk between
            bridge_employee_absence.start_date and
            bridge_employee_absence.end_date  
    ),
    final as (
        select
            --when
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_bk,
            --what
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.absence_type_bk,
            --how much
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time,
            
            case 
                when employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time = 'Days'             
                    then employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity / employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
                else employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
            end        as unit_quantity,
            
            case 
                when employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time = 'Days' 
                    then bc_employee.working_hours
                else employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
            end         as working_hours,
            
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.status,
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_employee_absence
            join
                employee_absence_date_cross_apply
                    ON bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk = employee_absence_date_cross_apply.employee_absence_bk
            left join
                bc_employee
                    ON bridge_employee_absence.employee_bk = bc_employee.employee_bk     
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_journal_lines_.description:
This model creates a layer to get the Business Keys required to link to other Dimensions.
    This model also extracts the Opportunity business keys from the Datavault and maps other BKs from manual files.
    This model applies exchange rates from stg_workday__exchange_rates to Workday Journal lines. 
    This allows for the Revenue_Amount to be in AUD.
model.cr_project.int_fact_journal_lines_.raw_code:
with
    bridge_journal_lines as (
        select
            journal_line_bk,
            journal_bk,
            region_bk,
            project_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,            
            client_bk,
            revenue_category_bk,            
            sales_item_bk,
            account_bk,
            company_bk,
            spend_category_bk,
            date_bk,
            status,
            currency,
            ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit,
            ledger_debit_amount,
            ledger_credit_amount,
            client_salesforce_position,
            record_source
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_journal_lines') }}
    ),
    opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project')}}
    ),
    opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity')}}
    ), 
    exchange_rates as (
        select 
            currency_rate,
            currency_rate_type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            source_currency
        from
            {{ref('bc_exchange_rates')}}
        where
            target_currency = 'AUD' and
            currency_rate_type = 'Average'
    ),
    manual_spend_category_revenue_category as (
        select
            spend_category_bk,
            revenue_category_bk

        from
            {{ref('stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category')}}
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            --when
            bridge_journal_lines.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_journal_lines.cost_center_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.practice_bk,

            --client_bk logic
            bridge_journal_lines.client_salesforce_position,
            bridge_journal_lines.client_bk              as journal_client_bk,
            opportunity.client_bk                       as opportunity_client_bk,                      
            iff(bridge_journal_lines.client_salesforce_position >= 1,
                bridge_journal_lines.client_bk,
                coalesce(
                    opportunity.client_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}'
                    )
                )                                       as client_bk,  
            bridge_journal_lines.account_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.company_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.client_account_director_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as client_account_director_bk,         
            --what
            bridge_journal_lines.journal_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.opportunity_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as opportunity_bk,
                bridge_journal_lines.journal_line_bk,
            iff(bridge_journal_lines.revenue_category_bk <> 'ghost',
                bridge_journal_lines.revenue_category_bk, 
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category.revenue_category_bk
                )                                       as revenue_category_bk,            
            bridge_journal_lines.spend_category_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.project_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.sales_item_bk,
            --where
            bridge_journal_lines.region_bk,
            --how much
                 bridge_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit,
                 bridge_journal_lines.ledger_debit_amount,
                 bridge_journal_lines.ledger_credit_amount,
                 bridge_journal_lines.currency,
                 ifnull(bridge_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit * exchange_rates.currency_rate,
                     bridge_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit) * -1      as revenue_amount,

            exchange_rates.source_currency,
            exchange_rates.currency_rate                 as exchange_rate,
            exchange_rates.effective_from                as exchange_rate_effective_from,
            exchange_rates.effective_to                  as exchange_rate_effective_to,
            bridge_journal_lines.status,
            bridge_journal_lines.record_source
        from 
            bridge_journal_lines
            left join
                opportunity_project
                    on bridge_journal_lines.project_bk = opportunity_project.project_bk
            left join
                opportunity
                    on opportunity_project.opportunity_bk = opportunity.opportunity_bk  
            left join
                exchange_rates
                    on bridge_journal_lines.date_bk
                        between exchange_rates.effective_from and exchange_rates.effective_to
                        and bridge_journal_lines.currency = exchange_rates.source_currency
            left join
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category
                    on
                        bridge_journal_lines.spend_category_bk = manual_spend_category_revenue_category.spend_category_bk                                                
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_opportunity_fi.raw_code:
with
    bridge_opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            LNK_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            OPPORTUNITY_BK, 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_SID, 
            RECORD_SOURCE, 
            LOAD_DATE_TIME
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_field_history') }}
    ),
    bc_opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            DATA_TYPE, 
            FIELD, 
            IS_DELETED, 
            NEW_VALUE, 
            OLD_VALUE, 
            CREATED_BY_ID, 
            CREATED_DATE, 
            RECORD_SOURCE, 
            LOAD_DATE_TIME
        from 
            {{ref('bc_opportunity_field_history')}}
    ),
    opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            bridge_opportunity_field_history.opportunity_bk,
            DATE(created_date) as date_bk,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.data_type,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.field,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.is_deleted,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.new_value,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.old_value,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.created_date,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.created_by_id,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.record_source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP  AS load_date_time
        from 
            bridge_opportunity_field_history
            join
                bc_opportunity_field_history
                    on bridge_opportunity_field_history.h_opportunity_field_history_sid = bc_opportunity_field_history.h_opportunity_field_history_sid 
        where field in ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            
    ),
    pivottable as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            date_bk,
            created_by_id,
            created_date,
            "'Amount'" as amount,
            "'StageName'" as stage_name,
            "'Start_Date__c'" as start_date__c,
            "'End_Date__c'" as end_date__c,
            record_source
        from
            opportunity_field_history
             PIVOT
            (
            Max(new_value)
            FOR Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            ) AS pivottable
            order by created_date desc
 
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK, DATE_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE desc) as rowNum,
            opportunity_bk,
            date_bk,
            created_date,
            created_by_id,
            LAST_VALUE(amount IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
            LAST_VALUE(stage_name IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS stage_name,
            LAST_VALUE(start_date__c IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS start_date,
            LAST_VALUE(end_date__c IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS end_date,
            record_source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as load_date_time
        FROM  
            pivottable
        order by created_date desc
    )
select
    opportunity_bk || '/' || date_bk as opportunity_field_history_bk,
    opportunity_bk,
    date_bk,
    created_date,
    created_by_id,
    amount,
    stage_name,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    record_source,
    load_date_time
from
    final
where rowNum = 1

model.cr_project.int_fact_project_revenu.name: int_fact_project_revenue__bks
model.cr_project.int_fact_project_revenu.description:
# Model: int_fact_project_revenue__bks

## Business Purpose
Creates an intermediate layer that assembles business keys and performs necessary transformations for the project revenue fact table.
This model enriches journal line data with opportunity relationships, applies exchange rate conversions, and resolves client attribution logic.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations

### Exchange Rate Conversion
- Applies average exchange rates from `bc_exchange_rates` to convert all amounts to AUD
- Joins on date and source currency to find applicable rate
- Revenue amount calculation: `(ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit * exchange_rate) * -1`
- Rounds to 2 decimal places as NUMBER(18,2)

### Revenue Category Mapping
- Primary source: `bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk`
- Fallback: Maps from spend category using `stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category`
- Uses manual mapping when revenue category is 'ghost'

### Data Filtering
- **Only includes Posted journal lines** (`status = 'Posted'`)
- Excludes cancelled transactions

## Sources & Dependencies

### Direct Dependencies
- `dvbridge_project_revenue` - Links to dimensions (journal, region, project, cost center, practice, client, revenue category, sales item, account, company, spend category)
- `bc_project_revenue` - Core revenue transaction data with amounts and metadata
- `dvbridge_opportunity_project` - Links projects to opportunities
- `dvbridge_opportunity` - Opportunity details including client and account director
- `bc_exchange_rates` - Currency conversion rates (filtered to AUD target, Average rate type)
- `stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category` - Manual mapping between spend and revenue categories

## Key Fields

### Grain
- `project_revenue_bk` - Unique identifier for each revenue transaction

### Measures
- `revenue_amount` - Converted AUD amount (posted transactions only)
- `exchange_rate` - Applied conversion rate
- `currency` - Original transaction currency

### Attributes
- `operational_transaction`, `header_memo`, `line_memo` - Transaction details
- `source`, `record_source` - Data lineage
- `status` - Journal status (filtered to 'Posted')
- `exchange_rate_effective_from`, `exchange_rate_effective_to` - Rate validity period

## Additional Notes
- Ghost records are used for missing optional relationships
- All revenue amounts are standardized to AUD for consistent reporting
- Complex client attribution logic supports both direct journal entries and opportunity-linked projects
- Manual revenue category mapping provides flexibility for unmapped spend categories
model.cr_project.int_fact_project_revenu.raw_code:
with
    bridge_project_revenue as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_project_revenue') }}
    ),
    opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project')}}
    ),
    opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity')}}
    ),
    dim_project as (
        select
            project_bk,
            primary_project_hierarchy
        from
            {{ ref('dim_project') }}
    ),
    exchange_rates as (
        select 
            currency_rate,
            currency_rate_type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            source_currency
        from
            {{ref('bc_exchange_rates')}}
        where
            target_currency = 'AUD' and
            currency_rate_type = 'Average'
    ),
    manual_spend_category_revenue_category as (
        select
            spend_category_bk,
            revenue_category_bk

        from
            {{ref('stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category')}}
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            --when
            bridge_project_revenue.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_project_revenue.cost_center_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.practice_bk,

            --client_bk logic
            bridge_project_revenue.client_salesforce_position,
            bridge_project_revenue.client_bk              as journal_client_bk,
            opportunity.client_bk                       as opportunity_client_bk,                      
            iff(bridge_project_revenue.client_salesforce_position >= 1,
                bridge_project_revenue.client_bk,
                coalesce(
                    opportunity.client_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}'
                    )
                )                                       as client_bk,  
            bridge_project_revenue.account_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.company_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.client_account_director_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as client_account_director_bk,         
            --what
            bridge_project_revenue.journal_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.opportunity_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as opportunity_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.project_revenue_bk,
            iff(bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk <> 'ghost',
                bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk, 
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category.revenue_category_bk
                )                                       as revenue_category_bk,            
            bridge_project_revenue.spend_category_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.project_bk,
            dim_project.primary_project_hierarchy,
            CASE
                WHEN dim_project.primary_project_hierarchy ILIKE '%: TM%' THEN 'Time and Materials'
                WHEN dim_project.primary_project_hierarchy ILIKE '%: FP%' THEN 'Fixed Price'
                ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(dim_project.primary_project_hierarchy, ':', 2)), '')
            END as project_billing_type,
            bridge_project_revenue.sales_item_bk,
            --where
            bridge_project_revenue.region_bk,
            --how much         
            bridge_project_revenue.currency,
            CAST(
                ROUND(
                    IFNULL(
                        bridge_project_revenue.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit
                        * exchange_rates.currency_rate,
                        bridge_project_revenue.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit
                    ) * -1,
                    2
                ) AS NUMBER(18,2)
            ) AS revenue_amount,
            bridge_project_revenue.operational_transaction, 
            bridge_project_revenue.header_memo, 
            bridge_project_revenue.line_memo,
            bridge_project_revenue.source,
            exchange_rates.source_currency,
            exchange_rates.currency_rate                 as exchange_rate,
            exchange_rates.effective_from                as exchange_rate_effective_from,
            exchange_rates.effective_to                  as exchange_rate_effective_to,
            bridge_project_revenue.status,
            bridge_project_revenue.effective_from,                   
            bridge_project_revenue.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_project_revenue
            left join
                opportunity_project
                    on bridge_project_revenue.project_bk = opportunity_project.project_bk
            left join
                opportunity
                    on opportunity_project.opportunity_bk = opportunity.opportunity_bk  
            left join
                dim_project
                    on bridge_project_revenue.project_bk = dim_project.project_bk
            left join
                exchange_rates
                    on bridge_project_revenue.date_bk 
                        between exchange_rates.effective_from and exchange_rates.effective_to
                        and bridge_project_revenue.currency = exchange_rates.source_currency
            left join
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category
                    on
                        bridge_project_revenue.spend_category_bk = manual_spend_category_revenue_category.spend_category_bk 
        where  bridge_project_revenue.status = 'Posted'                                          
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.name: int_fact_sow_amount__add_fte
model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.description:
This intermediate model enhances the sow amount data by calculating the estimated FTE percentage and weighted values(for Amount and FTE).
    - FTE formula is daily_amount / average_bill_rate( currently set to $2000)
    - Weighted values are calculated by multiplying the value with the Opportunity's Stage probability.
model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
    ) }}
with 
    opportunity_history as(
        select
            *
        from
            {{ref('ens_opportunity_daily_amount')}}
    ),
    employee_working_hours as (
        select
            median(working_hours) as hours
        from
            {{ref('bc_employee_current')}}
    ),
    stage_probability as (
        select
            stage_bk,
            probability
        from
            {{ref('bc_stage')}}     
    ),
    average_bill_rate as (
        select 2000 as amount
    ),
    final as (
        select
            opportunity_history.date_bk,
            opportunity_history.opportunity_bk,
            opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk,
            opportunity_history.service_offering,
            opportunity_history.project_bk,
            opportunity_history.revenue_category_bk,
            opportunity_history.third_party_product,
            opportunity_history.region_bk,
            opportunity_history.start_date,
            opportunity_history.end_date,
            opportunity_history.closed_date,
            opportunity_history.client_bk,
            opportunity_history.practice_bk,
            opportunity_history.business_unit,
            opportunity_history.client_account_director_bk,
            opportunity_history.stage_bk,
            opportunity_history.amount,
            opportunity_history.effective_from,
            opportunity_history.effective_to,
            opportunity_history.record_source,
            opportunity_history.load_date_time,
            opportunity_history.cost_center_bk,            
            opportunity_history.source_currency,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate_effective_from,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate_effective_to,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate,
            opportunity_history.number_of_working_days,
            opportunity_history.daily_amount,
            stage_probability.probability                                                                                as stage_probability,
            opportunity_history.daily_amount * stage_probability.probability                                             as weighted_amount,                                           
            round((opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount),2)                                       as fte,
            round((opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount),2) * stage_probability.probability       as weighted_fte,
            round((employee_working_hours.hours * (opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount)),2)      as hours        
        from 
            opportunity_history
            left join
                average_bill_rate
            left join
                employee_working_hours
            left join   
                stage_probability
                    on opportunity_history.stage_bk = stage_probability.stage_bk
    )
select 
    *
from 
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.name: int_fact_time_sheet__bks
model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.description:
This model sources all business keys and attributes directly from `bc_time_sheet`, which now contains the latest timesheet records and all required fields.

## Key Features
- Uses `bc_time_sheet` for both business keys and attributes (project, employee, cost center, practice, project role, etc.)
- Joins timesheet records to client dimension via project and opportunity bridge tables
- Enriches timesheets with cost rates from `bc_project_cost_rate` based on:
  - Employee assignment
  - Project assignment
  - Project role
  - Timesheet date falling within cost rate period
- Uses left join for cost rates since not all timesheets have matching cost rate records

## Cost Rate Logic
Cost rates are matched when the timesheet date falls within the cost rate's start and end date range. If no match is found, `cost_rate` and `cost_rate_currency` will be null.
model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.raw_code:
with
    bridge_opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from    
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project') }}
    ),      
    bridge_opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk
        from    
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity') }}
    ),
    -- Project cost rates with resolved overlaps
    bc_project_cost_rate as (
        select
            project_bk,
            employee_bk,
            project_role_bk,
            start_date,
            end_date,
            cost_rate,
            cost_rate_currency
        from
            {{ ref('bc_project_cost_rate') }}
    ),
    bc_standard_cost_rate as (
        select 
            project_role_bk, 
            standard_cost_rate, 
            effective_from, 
            effective_to, 
            currency
        from 
            {{ ref('bc_standard_cost_rate') }}
    ),
    dvbridge_time_sheet as (
        select
            timesheet_bk,
            project_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,
            employee_bk,
            project_role_bk,
            date_bk,      
            total_hours,
            billable_hours,
            billing_currency,
            billable_rate,
            override_rate,
            billing_status, 
            revenue_status, 
            invoice_number,
            timesheet_status,
            task_code,
            is_deleted,
            load_date_time,
            record_source
        from 
            {{ref('dvbridge_time_sheet')}}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            dvbridge_time_sheet.timesheet_bk,
            --when
            dvbridge_time_sheet.date_bk,
            --who
            dvbridge_time_sheet.employee_bk,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.cost_center_bk,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.practice_bk,
            bridge_opportunity.client_bk,
            --what
            dvbridge_time_sheet.project_bk,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.project_role_bk,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.invoice_number,
            --how much
            dvbridge_time_sheet.total_hours,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.billable_hours,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.billable_rate,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.override_rate,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.billing_currency,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.timesheet_status,
            -- Cost rate from project cost rate (may be null if no match)
            bc_project_cost_rate.cost_rate,
            bc_project_cost_rate.cost_rate_currency,
            bc_standard_cost_rate.standard_cost_rate, 
            dvbridge_time_sheet.task_code,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.load_date_time,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.record_source,
            dvbridge_time_sheet.is_deleted,
           -- how
            dvbridge_time_sheet.billing_status, 
            dvbridge_time_sheet.revenue_status
        from 
            dvbridge_time_sheet
            left join
                bridge_opportunity_project
                    on dvbridge_time_sheet.project_bk = bridge_opportunity_project.project_bk
            left join
                bridge_opportunity
                    on bridge_opportunity_project.opportunity_bk = bridge_opportunity.opportunity_bk
            -- Join to project cost rates on employee, project, role, and date range
            left join
                bc_project_cost_rate
                    on dvbridge_time_sheet.employee_bk = bc_project_cost_rate.employee_bk
                   and dvbridge_time_sheet.project_bk = bc_project_cost_rate.project_bk
                   and dvbridge_time_sheet.project_role_bk = bc_project_cost_rate.project_role_bk
                   and dvbridge_time_sheet.date_bk between bc_project_cost_rate.start_date and bc_project_cost_rate.end_date
            left join 
                bc_standard_cost_rate
                    on dvbridge_time_sheet.project_role_bk = bc_standard_cost_rate.project_role_bk
                    and dvbridge_time_sheet.billing_currency = bc_standard_cost_rate.currency
                    and dvbridge_time_sheet.date_bk between bc_standard_cost_rate.effective_from and bc_standard_cost_rate.effective_to
        where
            dvbridge_time_sheet.is_deleted = false
    )
select
    timesheet_bk,
    date_bk,
    employee_bk,
    cost_center_bk,
    practice_bk,
    project_bk,
    project_role_bk,
    client_bk,
    total_hours,
    billable_hours,
    override_rate,
    billable_rate,
    billing_currency,
    cost_rate,
    cost_rate_currency,
    standard_cost_rate,
    timesheet_status,
    billing_status, 
    revenue_status, 
    invoice_number,
    task_code,
    is_deleted,
    load_date_time,
    record_source
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_lnk_opportunity_fie.description:
This model creates a Datavault Link between the Opportunity History Business Concepts and the following concepts:
    
    Opportunity
model.cr_project.int_lnk_opportunity_fie.raw_code:
with 
    int_dv_opportunity_field_history as (
        select 
            *
        from {{ ref( 'int_dv_opportunity_field_history' ) }}
        where Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
    ),
    pivottable as (
        select
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID,
            OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            CREATED_DATE,
            CREATED_BY_ID,
            "'Amount'" as AMOUNT,
            "'StageName'" as STAGE_NAME,
            "'Start_Date__c'" as START_DATE__C,
            "'End_Date__c'" as END_DATE__C,
            RECORD_SOURCE
        from
            int_dv_opportunity_field_history
             PIVOT
            (
            Max(NEW_VALUE)
            FOR Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            ) AS pivottable
            -- where opportunityid in ('0069o000003Ei7eAAC')
            order by CREATED_DATE desc
 
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID,
            OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            CREATED_DATE,
            CREATED_BY_ID,
            LAST_VALUE(AMOUNT IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS AMOUNT,
            LAST_VALUE(STAGE_NAME IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS STAGE_NAME,
            LAST_VALUE(START_DATE__C IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS START_DATE,
            LAST_VALUE(END_DATE__C IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS END_DATE,
            RECORD_SOURCE
        FROM 
            pivottable
        order by CREATED_DATE desc
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_opportunity_actuals.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized='table',
    cluster_by=['dim_opportunity_sid', 'month_start_date']
  )
}}

with
    aggregate_revenue as (
        select
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            month_start_date,
            sum(revenue_amount) as revenue_amount  
        from
            {{ ref('agg_actual_revenue__month_start_date') }}
        group by
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            month_start_date
    ),
    actuals_tracker as (
        select
            date,
            revenue_type,
            dbt_valid_from,
            dbt_valid_to
        from
            {{ ref('bridge_actuals_tracker') }}
        where               
            -- force view to use current snapshot for current jira card eag-1748, as to limit scope
            -- snapshots to be taken into account via eag-1735
            current_timestamp() between dbt_valid_from and dbt_valid_to
    ),
    aggregate_revenue_actuals as (
        select
            aggregate_revenue.dim_opportunity_sid,
            aggregate_revenue.month_start_date,
            aggregate_revenue.revenue_amount,
            actuals_tracker.revenue_type
        from
            aggregate_revenue
        left join actuals_tracker
            on aggregate_revenue.month_start_date = actuals_tracker.date
        where actuals_tracker.revenue_type = 'ACTUALS'
    ),
    final as (
        select
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            month_start_date,
            revenue_type,
            revenue_amount
        from
            aggregate_revenue_actuals
    )
select
    *
from
    final
order by dim_opportunity_sid, month_start_date

model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.name: int_opportunity_exposure_forecast
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.description:
This model enriches the opportunity_exposure model with Forecasting information to allow the following forecasting methods to filter on projects
    as well as beginning to replace the mappings that are performed in the int__booking_forecast model
Using this method allows for a single mapping point for models that do and don't use EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST
    as non EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST models will also need the mapping done in int__booking_forecast

As per March 2026, The `dvbridge_booking` reference is now filtered to only include the most current version of each forecast record (`current_timestamp() between effective_from and effective_to`), as historical cost rate tracking (SCD2 behaviour) is not required for utilisation or project profitability reporting and only focuses on current/future cost rates.
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.raw_code:
{{
	config(
    	materialized = 'table'
	) 
}}
WITH
    OPPORTUNITIES AS (
        SELECT
            *
        FROM
            {{ ref('exposure_opportunity') }}
    )
    , ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT AS (
        SELECT
            FORECAST_START_DATE_BK
        FROM
            {{ ref('int_actuals_tracker_current_month') }}
    )
    , FORECAST_LINES AS (
        SELECT
            *,
            1 as force_github
        FROM
            {{ref('dvbridge_booking')}}
    )
    , OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY AS (
        SELECT
            PROJECT_BK,
            LISTAGG(DISTINCT CONTRACT_BILLING_RATE, ',' ) as PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES,
            LISTAGG(DISTINCT PROJECT_BILLING_TYPE, ',' ) as PROJECT_BILLING_TYPE
        FROM
            FORECAST_LINES
        WHERE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_FROM AND EFFECTIVE_TO
        GROUP BY PROJECT_BK
    )
    , FINAL AS (
        SELECT
            OPPORTUNITIES.*,
            OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY.PROJECT_BILLING_TYPE,
            OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY.PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES,
            (PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES = '0' OR PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES IS NULL) AS NO_PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES,
            (
                PRIMARY_PROJECT_HIERARCHY IN ('Prof Serve: TM')
                AND STAGE_BK = 'CLOSED_WON'
                and WORKDAY_PROJECT_STATE IN ('Active', 'Pending Close', 'Closed')
                AND (
                    NO_PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES
                    -- OR DEAL_VALUE = 0
                )
            ) AS IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES_BASE,
            COALESCE(IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES_BASE, false) as IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES,
            ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT.FORECAST_START_DATE_BK
        FROM
            OPPORTUNITIES
            LEFT JOIN
                OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY
                    ON OPPORTUNITIES.PROJECT_BK = OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY.PROJECT_BK
            LEFT JOIN
                ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT
    )
SELECT
    *
FROM
    FINAL
-- WHERE IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES   
-- WHERE IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES IS NULL 
-- WHERE project_bk = 'DBS-035-CLD-TM'

model.cr_project.int_opportunity_history.name: int_opportunity_history
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_history.description:
This model merges the current and historical view of an Opportunity.
    Some fields are present in oth, and so this provides a historical view, enriched with 'live' attributes,
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_history.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}
with stg_salesforce__opportunity as (
	select
		*
	from
		{{ ref('snapshot_salesforce_opportunity') }}
	where
		dbt_valid_to is null and dbt_is_deleted = 'False'
)
select
	-- when
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.start_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.end_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.closed_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.last_modified_date,
	-- where
		CASE 
			WHEN stg_salesforce__opportunity.region_bk = 'USA' THEN 'International'
			ELSE stg_salesforce__opportunity.region_bk END AS region,
	-- how
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_deleted,
		coalesce(
            dvbridge_opportunity_history.stage_bk,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.stage_bk
        )                                                   as stage_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.next_step,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.forecast_category,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.forecast_category_name,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_closed,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_won,
	-- how much
		coalesce(
		dvbridge_opportunity_history.amount,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.amount
            )                                               as amount,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.probability,
	-- who
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.client_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.practice_bk as practice,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.practice_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.client_account_director_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.business_unit, 
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.pricing_structure,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.revenue_recognition_type,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.third_party_product,
	-- what
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.opportunity_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.service_offering,
		ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk, 'ghost')  as opportunity_history_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.project_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.type,
	-- audit
        coalesce(
			dvbridge_opportunity_history.effective_from,
            to_date('{{var('low_date')}}')
        )                                               as effective_from,
		coalesce(
            dateadd(
                nanosecond, -1,
				lead(dvbridge_opportunity_history.effective_from) over (
					partition by dvbridge_opportunity_history.h_opportunity_sid

		current_timestamp                               as load_date_time
FROM

with stg_salesforce__opportunity as (
	select
		*
	from
		snapshots.snapshot_salesforce_opportunity
	where
		dbt_valid_to is null and dbt_is_deleted = 'False'
)
select
	-- when
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.start_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.end_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.closed_date,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.last_modified_date,
	-- where
		CASE 
			WHEN stg_salesforce__opportunity.region_bk = 'USA' THEN 'International'
			ELSE stg_salesforce__opportunity.region_bk END AS region,
	-- how
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_deleted,
		coalesce(
            dvbridge_opportunity_history.stage_bk,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.stage_bk
        )                                                   as stage_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.next_step,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.forecast_category,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.forecast_category_name,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_closed,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_won,
	-- how much
		coalesce(
		dvbridge_opportunity_history.amount,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.amount
            )                                               as amount,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.probability,
	-- who
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.client_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.practice_bk as practice,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.practice_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.client_account_director_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.business_unit, 
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.pricing_structure,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.revenue_recognition_type,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.third_party_product,
	-- what
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.opportunity_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.service_offering,
		ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk, 'ghost')  as opportunity_history_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.project_bk,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.type,
	-- audit
        coalesce(
			dvbridge_opportunity_history.effective_from,
            to_date('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
        )                                               as effective_from,
		coalesce(
            dateadd(
                nanosecond, -1,
				lead(dvbridge_opportunity_history.effective_from) over (
					partition by dvbridge_opportunity_history.h_opportunity_sid
					order by dvbridge_opportunity_history.effective_from
                )
        ), '2900-12-31 00:00:00')                      as effective_to,
        coalesce(
			dvbridge_opportunity_history.record_source,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.record_source
        )                                               as record_source,
		current_timestamp                               as load_date_time
FROM
	stg_salesforce__opportunity
	left join 
		datavault__business.dvbridge_opportunity_history
        on stg_salesforce__opportunity.opportunity_bk = dvbridge_opportunity_history.opportunity_bk

model.cr_project.int_tlnk_opportunity_ma.description:
This model creates a SID generation layer for the int_tlnk_opportunity model, in preparation for tlnk_opportunity

We replaced the `left join` with an `inner join` to enforce stricter mapping integrity between Salesforce values and Workday cost centres.  
To prevent data loss from unmapped combinations, we introduced ghost values in the mapping seed file 
for unmatched Region–Business Unit–Practice combinations.

This ensures complete and consistent mappings while maintaining join integrity.
model.cr_project.int_tlnk_opportunity_ma.raw_code:
with 
	revenue_category as (
	    select
	        map_revenue_category_bk,
	        revenue_category_bk
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__revenue_category__mapping' ) }}
    	), 
	practice as (
	    select
	        division,
			practice_bk
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__xero_workday_practice_mappings' ) }}
    	), 	
    cost_center as (
        select
            cost_center_bk,
            region,
            business_unit,
            practice
        from
            {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__salesforce_workday_mappings' ) }}
        ),
	salesforce_opportunity as (
	    select
	        opportunity_bk,
			practice_bk 		as division,
			business_unit,
	        amount,
	        start_date,
	        end_date,
	        region_bk,
            client_bk,
            stage_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
			map_revenue_category_bk,
            cost_center_code__c as salesforce_cost_centre_id,
	        last_modified_date,
	        record_source,
	        dbt_is_deleted,
			dbt_valid_to
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'snapshot_salesforce_opportunity' ) }}
    	), 
    bc_cost_center as (
        select
			distinct
            cost_center_bk,
            salesforce_cost_centre_id
        from {{ ref('snapshot_salesforce_cost_center') }}
		where dbt_valid_to is null
    ),
	final as (
	    select
	        salesforce_opportunity.opportunity_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.last_modified_date,
	        salesforce_opportunity.amount as sow_value,
	        salesforce_opportunity.start_date,
	        salesforce_opportunity.end_date,
	        salesforce_opportunity.record_source,
	        salesforce_opportunity.client_account_director_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.client_bk,
	        revenue_category.revenue_category_bk,
	        practice.practice_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.region_bk,
            coalesce(bc_cost_center.cost_center_bk , cost_center.cost_center_bk) as cost_center_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.stage_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.dbt_is_deleted, 
			salesforce_opportunity.dbt_valid_to
	    from
	        salesforce_opportunity
		        left join
		            revenue_category
		                on
		                    salesforce_opportunity.map_revenue_category_bk = revenue_category.map_revenue_category_bk
		        left join
		            practice
		                on
		                    salesforce_opportunity.division = practice.division
		        join
		            cost_center
		                on
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.region_bk) = cost_center.region and 
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.business_unit) = cost_center.business_unit and 
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.division) = cost_center.practice
                left join bc_cost_center
                    on salesforce_opportunity.salesforce_cost_centre_id = bc_cost_center.salesforce_cost_centre_id
	)
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_tlnk_standard_cost_.description:
# Model: int_tlnk_standard_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
This intermediate model (t-link) is designed to capture the relationship between standard cost rates and their associated business keys in the Data Vault raw layer. It serves as a link table to support historical tracking and integration of cost rate changes across related entities.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Joins and integrates relevant business keys and cost rate information from staging and/or snapshot sources.
- Ensures each link is uniquely identified and tracks changes over time.
- Applies Data Vault modeling conventions for t-link structures.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Depends on the standard cost rate snapshot and related hub/satellite models in the Data Vault raw layer.
- Main source: `snapshot_standard_cost_rate` or equivalent staging/snapshot model.

## Key Fields
- Business key fields (e.g., Project_Role_ID, other related keys)
- Standard_Cost_Rate and Effective_From
- Metadata fields for record source and load timestamp

## Update Frequency
- Updated as part of the dbt pipeline whenever upstream data changes or snapshots are refreshed.

## Additional Notes
- Follows Data Vault best practices for t-link modeling.
- Documentation and tests are maintained in accordance with the project style guide.

model.cr_project.pit_account_current.compiled_code:
-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_account

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_account
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_account_current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_ACCOUNT_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_account AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_account_current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_account as b
        ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = b.H_ACCOUNT_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID),
                 
                 CAST('00000000000000000000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
                 
        AS sat_account_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_account_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_account AS sat_account_src
            ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID
            AND sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_account AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID),
                 CAST('00000000000000000000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_account_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000000'))
        AS sat_account_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_account AS sat_account_src
            ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID
            AND sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit

- Client ID
- Satellite attributes

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each DBT project run.

- Supports current-state reporting for client business concept.

with 
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates
    sat_employee_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee
    ),
    sat_employee_cost_centre_change_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_cost_centre_change
    ),
    sat_employee_manager_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_manager
    ),
    sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy
    ),
    union_sat_as_of_dates as (        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_manager_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_as_of_date
        
    ),
    generated_as_of_dates as (
        select distinct *
        from union_sat_as_of_dates
    ),
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates 
    rows_as_of_dates as (
        select
            hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            as_of_dates.as_of_date
        from
            datavault__raw.hub_employee hub
        left join
            generated_as_of_dates as_of_dates             
            on hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID  = as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
          
    ),
    sat_employee_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee
    ),
    sat_employee_cost_centre_change_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_cost_centre_change
    ),
    sat_employee_manager_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_manager
    ),
    sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy
    ),          
    row_sats as (
        select
            rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date,
            -- ghost
            
    CAST(MD5_BINARY(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST('ghost' AS VARCHAR))), '')) AS BINARY(16)) AS hk_ghost,
            cast('1900-01-01 00:00:00' as timestamp) as early_date,
            sat_employee_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_pk,
            sat_employee_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_ldts,
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk,
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts,
            sat_employee_manager_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_manager_pk,
            sat_employee_manager_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_manager_ldts,
            sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_pk,
            sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_ldts  
        from
            rows_as_of_dates
            left join
                 sat_employee_effective_dates as sat_employee_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_employee_cost_centre_change_effective_dates as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_employee_manager_effective_dates as sat_employee_manager_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_manager_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_manager_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_manager_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_effective_dates as sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_src.effective_to       

    ),
    final as (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            coalesce(as_of_date, early_date) as as_of_date, 
            'Workday' as record_source,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_manager_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_manager_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_manager_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_manager_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_organisation_hierarchy_ldts    
        from
            row_sats 
    )    
select
    *
from
    final

with 
    employee as (
        select
            dim_employee_sid,
            employee_bk,
            first_name,
            last_name,
            work_email,
            location,
            hire_date,
            termination_date
        from

    ),
    forecast_booking as (
        select
            dim_employee_sid,
            dim_project_sid,
            dim_project_role_sid,
            dim_date_sid, 
            forecasted_hours
        from

    ),
    project as (

            project_bk,

            end_date,
            project_owner,
            project_status,
            practice_name,
            project_region,
            cost_center

    ),
    project_role as (
        select
            dim_project_role_sid,
            project_role_bk,
            project_role
        from
            {{ ref('dim_project_role')}}
    ),
    forecast_date as (
        select
            dim_date_sid,
            date                  as forecast_date
        from {{ ref('dim_date')}}

    final as (
        select employee.employee_bk,
                employee.first_name,
                employee.last_name,
                employee.work_email,
                employee.location,
                employee.hire_date,
                employee.termination_date,
                forecast_booking.forecasted_hours,

model.cr_project.rep_revenue_r1_r4.description:
# Model: rep_revenue_r1_r4

## Business Purpose
Rollup of forecasting and actuals data from rep_revenue, mapped to Salesforce stages.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Cross-applies Stage Business Concept to 'Rollup' stage reporting.
- Maps Salesforce stages to R5-R1 confidence levels.

## Sources & Dependencies
- rep_revenue

## Key Fields
- Opportunity ID, Stage, Amount

## Update Frequency
- As per dbt run.

## Additional Notes
- Each opportunity appears in its stage and all mapped rollup stages.
model.cr_project.rep_revenue_r1_r4.raw_code:
{{config(
    materialized = 'table'
)}}
with
    r1 as (
        select
            dim_stage_sid,
            (
                select
                    dim_stage_sid
                from
                    {{ref('dim_stage')}}
                where 
                    stage_bk = 'R1'
            )   as r_dim_stage_sid
        from 
            {{ref('dim_stage')}}
        where 
            r1 = true
    ),
    r2 as (
        select
            dim_stage_sid,
            (
                select
                    dim_stage_sid
                from
                    {{ref('dim_stage')}}
                where 
                    stage_bk = 'R2'
            )   as r_dim_stage_sid
        from 
            {{ref('dim_stage')}}
        where 
            r2= true
    ),
    r3 as (
        select
            dim_stage_sid,
            (
                select
                    dim_stage_sid
                from
                    {{ref('dim_stage')}}
                where 
                    stage_bk = 'R3'
            )   as r_dim_stage_sid
        from 
            {{ref('dim_stage')}}
        where 
            r3 = true
    ),
    r4 as (
        select
            dim_stage_sid,
            (
                select
                    dim_stage_sid
                from
                    {{ref('dim_stage')}}
                where 
                    stage_bk = 'R4'
            )   as r_dim_stage_sid
        from 
            {{ref('dim_stage')}}
        where 
            r4 = true
    ),
    r5 as (
        select
            dim_stage_sid,
            (
                select
                    dim_stage_sid
                from
                    {{ref('dim_stage')}}
                where 
                    stage_bk = 'R5'
            )   as r_dim_stage_sid
        from 
            {{ref('dim_stage')}}
        where 
            r5 = true
    ),
    union_all as (
        -- Low Level Stages
        select 
            *,
            dim_stage_sid as r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
        -- R1
        union all
        select 
            rep_revenue.*,
            r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
            join
                r1
                on
                    rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = r1.dim_stage_sid
        union all
        select 
            rep_revenue.*,
            r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
            join
                r2
                on
                    rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = r2.dim_stage_sid
        union all
        select 
            rep_revenue.*,
            r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
            join
                r3
                on
                    rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = r3.dim_stage_sid
        union all
        select 
            rep_revenue.*,
            r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
            join
                r4
                on
                    rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = r4.dim_stage_sid
        union all
        select 
            rep_revenue.*,
            r_dim_stage_sid
        from
            {{ref('rep_revenue')}}
            join
                r5
                on
                    rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = r5.dim_stage_sid
    )
select
    dim_date_sid,
    dim_region_sid,
    r_dim_stage_sid as dim_stage_sid,
    cr_type,
    dim_client_sid,
    dim_cost_center_sid,
    dim_client_account_director_sid,
    dim_practice_sid,
    dim_opportunity_sid,
    dim_project_sid,
    dim_revenue_category_sid,
    dim_sales_item_sid,
    amount,
    weighted_amount,
    fte,
    weighted_fte,
    hours,
    effective_from,
    effective_to,
    record_source,
    table_source,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() load_date_time
from
    union_all

# Model: rep_revenue_r1_r4_snapshot

## Business Purpose
Snapshots rep_revenue_r1_r4 at a current Point In Time for historical comparison.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations

## Sources & Dependencies

{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        pre_hook="DELETE FROM {{this}} WHERE SNAPSHOT_DATE_BK = CURRENT_DATE()"
    )
}}

SELECT
    TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE()) as SNAPSHOT_DATE_BK,
    {{automate_dv.hash('SNAPSHOT_DATE_BK','SNAPSHOT_DIM_DATE_SID')}},
    DIM_DATE_SID,
    DIM_REGION_SID,
    DIM_STAGE_SID,
    CR_TYPE,
    DIM_CLIENT_SID,
    DIM_COST_CENTER_SID,
    DIM_CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_SID,
    DIM_PRACTICE_SID,
    DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
    DIM_PROJECT_SID,
    DIM_REVENUE_CATEGORY_SID,
    DIM_SALES_ITEM_SID,
    AMOUNT,
    WEIGHTED_AMOUNT,
    FTE,
    WEIGHTED_FTE,
    HOURS,
    EFFECTIVE_FROM,
    EFFECTIVE_TO,
    RECORD_SOURCE,
    TABLE_SOURCE
FROM
    {{ ref('rep_revenue_r1_r4') }}
-- Only obtain the 'current snapshot' of the table as we are creating an artificial PIT from partial PIT data
-- In the future this whole table will fully support PITs and so this filter can be removed
WHERE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_FROM AND EFFECTIVE_TO

{% if is_incremental() %}
-- Wrap in 'is_incremental' so that results can been seen in DBT Cloud Preview
-- Only insert records on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
-- To allow for Amy to choose a specific day to use as a snapshot incase it takes until Thursday to get a 'good' run
AND DAYOFWEEK( CURRENT_DATE() ) IN (2, 3, 4)
{% endif %}

model.cr_project.rep_revenue_r1_r4_sow_f.description:
# Model: rep_revenue_r1_r4_sow_filtered

## Business Purpose
Provides a focused view of Statement of Work (SOW) revenue data from rep_revenue_r1_r4 with a 3-year rolling window for performance optimization and targeted analysis specifically for DataRails usage.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Filters for fact_sow_amount source records only (table_source = 'fact_sow_amount').
- Applies 3-year rolling date filter starting from January 1st, three years prior to current year.
- Joins with dim_date to filter on actual date values rather than surrogate keys.
- Example: As of January 2026, includes records from January 1, 2023 onwards.

## Sources & Dependencies
- rep_revenue_r1_r4
- dim_date

## Key Fields
- All fields from rep_revenue_r1_r4
- table_source: Always 'fact_sow_amount'
- dim_date_sid: Links to dim_date for date filtering

## Update Frequency
- As per dbt run.

## Additional Notes
- Materialized as table for improved query performance.
- Reduces data volume for downstream reporting and analysis.
- Date filter recalculates dynamically based on current year start date.
model.cr_project.rep_revenue_r1_r4_sow_f.raw_code:
{{config(
    materialized = 'table'
)}}

select
    rep_revenue_r1_r4.*
from
    {{ ref('rep_revenue_r1_r4') }}
    inner join
        {{ ref('dim_date') }}
        on rep_revenue_r1_r4.dim_date_sid = dim_date.dim_date_sid
where
    rep_revenue_r1_r4.table_source = 'fact_sow_amount'
    and dim_date.date >= dateadd(year, -3, date_trunc('year', current_date()))
    and current_date >= rep_revenue_r1_r4.effective_from
    and current_date < rep_revenue_r1_r4.effective_to
