WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT a.H_ACCOUNT_SID, a.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF, a.ACCOUNT_BK, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, a.LOAD_DATE_TIME, a.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_account AS a
    WHERE a.H_ACCOUNT_SID IS NOT NULL
),

latest_records AS (
    SELECT current_records.H_ACCOUNT_SID, current_records.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF, current_records.LOAD_DATE_TIME
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__raw.sat_account AS current_records
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT source_data.H_ACCOUNT_SID
        FROM source_data
    ) AS source_records
        ON source_records.H_ACCOUNT_SID = current_records.H_ACCOUNT_SID
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY current_records.H_ACCOUNT_SID
        ORDER BY current_records.LOAD_DATE_TIME DESC
    ) = 1
),

unique_source_records AS (
    SELECT
        sd.H_ACCOUNT_SID, sd.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF, sd.ACCOUNT_BK, sd.ACCOUNT_NAME, sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM source_data AS sd
    LEFT OUTER JOIN latest_records AS lr
        ON sd.H_ACCOUNT_SID = lr.H_ACCOUNT_SID

    QUALIFY sd.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF !=
        LAG(sd.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF, 1,
            COALESCE(
                lr.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF,
                CAST('FFFFFFFF' AS BINARY(16))
            )
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sd.H_ACCOUNT_SID
            ORDER BY sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME ASC
        )
),

records_to_insert AS (
    SELECT usr.H_ACCOUNT_SID, usr.ACCOUNT_HASHDIFF, usr.ACCOUNT_BK, usr.ACCOUNT_NAME, usr.LOAD_DATE_TIME, usr.RECORD_SOURCE

## Business Purpose
This datavault satellite contains client attribute data sourced from Workday, including industry, Workday ID, and alternate names. It tracks historical changes to these attributes over time.

- `client_hashdiff` — Hash of payload columns for change detection.
- `client_name` — Client name from Workday.
- `industry` — Industry classification from Workday.
- `workday_id` — Unique Workday customer identifier.
- `alternate_names` — Alternate names for the customer in Workday.

## Update Frequency
- Incrementally loaded on each dbt run.

# Model: stg_manual__absence_type_deductible_supply_hours

## Business Purpose
Provides a lookup list of absence types that are deductible from supply hours, mapped from their Workday business key to their display name. Standardises absence handling logic that was previously only implemented in Power BI.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Contains only absence types that should reduce supply hours.
- Downstream models join on `absence_type_bk` or `absence_name` to determine whether an absence should be deducted from supply hours.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Seed file: `data/landing_manual/absence_type_deductible_supply_hours.csv`
- Used downstream by `dim_absence_type` and supply hours / utilisation calculations.

## Key Fields
- `absence_type_bk` — the absence type business key as it appears in Workday
- `absence_name` — the display name of the absence type

## Update Frequency
- Updated manually when new deductible absence types are introduced in Workday.

## Additional Notes
- Related ticket: introduces a controlled mapping to replace ad-hoc Power BI logic.
- See `dim_absence_type` for the downstream usage of this lookup.

model.cr_project.stg_manual_actuals_trac.name: stg_manual_actuals_tracker
model.cr_project.stg_manual_actuals_trac.description:
This view obtains data from the Manual S3 CSV upload 'actuals_tracker.csv'
      
      Finance have a process of approving actuals for a month.
      If a month's actuals have not been approved, and is in a incomplete month, we dont want to include these Actuals in calculations

      The Actuals Tracker allows for the filtering of months in Actuals and Forecast models being PRE and POST this demarkation month.

      After the file is modified in S3 bucket, an SQL query should be created with 
      ```sql
        CREATE OR REPLACE EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER
            LOCATION = @MANUAL_FILES_API_STAGE/
            AUTO_REFRESH = FALSE
            PATTERN = "manual_uploads/actuals_tracker/data/actuals_tracker(?:.*)(?:.csv)"
            FILE_FORMAT = CSV_FMT;

        GRANT OWNERSHIP ON EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER TO ROLE REPORTING_ANALYTICS_DBA;
        GRANT SELECT ON EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER TO ROLE REPORTING_ANALYTICS_PROD_SUPPORT_DBA;
     ```
     See full implementation context and history in:
     [EAG-1745](https://versent.atlassian.net/browse/EAG-1745)
     [EAG-1200](https://versent.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/EAG/boards/358?selectedIssue=EAG-3200)

     This model includes a recency test specified in manual_schema.yml to ensure data freshness based on the file_timestamp column.
     The threshold has been updated to 360 days to reflect the expected update frequency of the source file, with the change in the value of interval
     This change is linked to [EAG-3193](https://versent.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/EAG/boards/358?selectedIssue=EAG-3193)
     Related dbt docs here: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-utils/tree/1.3.0/#recency-source

# Model: stg_manual_bundled

## Business Purpose
Legacy model to allow for old Forecasted Projects via the 'bundled.csv' method to reach the CRR. Used to overwrite Actuals from Xero/Harvest until Xero actuals were fixed.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Overwrites actuals using bundled.csv file.
- No longer required if Xero is reconciled; check with finance before removal.
- Previously used for forecasting future data, but now obsolete for that purpose.

## Sources & Dependencies
- bundled.csv manual file
- Xero/Harvest actuals

## Key Fields
- Project ID
- Forecast/Actual values

## Update Frequency
- No longer updated; legacy only.

## Additional Notes
- Data could be removed if confirmed with finance.

- Opportunity/Project ID

model.cr_project.stg_salesforce__opportu.description:
This model extracts Opportunity data from the Salesforce API and exposes it to the Data Warehouse.
    It renames Salesforce field names to that of the Data Warehouse's BK naming schemes.

    The test test_salesforce_workday_cost_enter_mapping() is executed within this model to ensure that all Salesforce entries for region, business, and 
    practice are correctly mapped to corresponding Workday values. 
    These mappings are essential for deriving the appropriate cost centre in Workday for each opportunity.

    default_keys as (

            upper(project_code__c)                                                  as project_bk,
            replace(upper(stage_name), ' ', '_')                                    as stage_bk,
            IFF(REGION_SALES__C = 'Transurban', 'REG_SOUTH', REGION_SALES__C)       as region_bk,
            {{default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('account_id')}}                  as client_bk,
            {{default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('SERVICE_OFFERING__C')}}         as service_offering,
            {{default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('Revenue_Recognition_Type__c')}} as revenue_recognition_type,
            {{default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('X3rd_Party_Product__c')}}       as third_party_product,
            {{default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('Pricing_Structure__c')}}        as Pricing_Structure,
            CASE
                WHEN Sub_Contracted__c IN ('Telstra Internal',
                                            'Telstra Paper - Mixed Delivery',
                                            'Telstra Paper - Versent Delivery',
                                            'Versent Paper - Mixed Delivery',
                                            'Versent Paper - Telstra Delivery')
                    THEN Sub_Contracted__c
                ELSE
                    'ghost'
            END                                                                     as subcontracted
        from
            ext_opportunity
    ),
    final as (
        select
            --when
            --where

            concat_ws('|', 
                business_unit, 
                pricing_structure, 
                service_offering, 
                third_party_product, 
                revenue_recognition_type,
                subcontracted
                )                                                                   as map_revenue_category_bk,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as load_date_time,
            default_keys.* -- ultimately get rid of this when decommission stg_opportunity_salesforce, currently a bit too big a job!!! - TN
        from
            default_keys
    )

        select

            replace(upper(stage_name), ' ', '_')                                    as stage_bk,
            IFF(REGION_SALES__C = 'Transurban', 'REG_SOUTH', REGION_SALES__C)       as region_bk,
            
    IFNULL( account_id, 'ghost') 
                  as client_bk,
            
    IFNULL( SERVICE_OFFERING__C, 'ghost') 
         as service_offering,
            
    IFNULL( Revenue_Recognition_Type__c, 'ghost') 
 as revenue_recognition_type,
            
    IFNULL( X3rd_Party_Product__c, 'ghost') 
       as third_party_product,
            
    IFNULL( Pricing_Structure__c, 'ghost')

                                            'Versent Paper - Mixed Delivery',
                                            'Versent Paper - Telstra Delivery')
                    THEN Sub_Contracted__c
                ELSE
                    'ghost'
            END                                                                     as subcontracted
        from
            ext_opportunity
    ),
    final as (
        select
            --when
            --where

            concat_ws('|', 
                business_unit, 
                pricing_structure, 
                service_offering, 
                third_party_product, 
                revenue_recognition_type,
                subcontracted
                )                                                                   as map_revenue_category_bk,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as load_date_time,
            default_keys.* -- ultimately get rid of this when decommission stg_opportunity_salesforce, currently a bit too big a job!!! - TN
        from
            default_keys
    )
select * from final

                f.value:Invoice::varchar(200) as invoice,

                f.value:Customer_Status::varchar(50) as customer_status,

                f.value:Currency::varchar(10) as currency,
                f.value:Invoice_Amount::number(20,2) as invoice_amount,
                f.value:EX_GST_Amount::number(20,2) as ex_gst_amount,

model.cr_project.stg_workday__exchange_r.name: stg_workday__exchange_rates
model.cr_project.stg_workday__exchange_r.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Exchange Rate data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Exchange_Rates**
    This data allows for historical Workday transactions of many curriencies to be converted into the current days AUD exchange rate
    The data is used in conjunction with Workday Actuals in (int_fact_actual_revenue) and pre-CLOSED_WON forcasting in fact_sow_amount
model.cr_project.stg_workday__exchange_r.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_EXCHANGE_RATES REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
    default_exchange_rate_union as (
        SELECT 
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(f.value:Currency_Rate_Timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SSTZH:TZM'
                )                                       as Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(f.value:Created_Moment), 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS.FF9TZH:TZM'
                )                                       as Created_Moment,                    
            f.value:Currency_Rate::varchar(50)          as Currency_Rate,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Month::varchar(50)    as Currency_Rate_Month,
            f.value:Source_Currency::varchar(50)        as Source_Currency,
            f.value:Target_Currency::varchar(50)        as Target_Currency,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Type::varchar(50)     as Currency_Rate_Type,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Year::varchar(50)     as Currency_Rate_Year, 
            f.value:Financial_Year::varchar(50)         as Financial_Year,
            METADATA$FILENAME                           as record_source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_exchange_rates') }}, table(flatten(value)) f

        UNION

        SELECT
            TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
            TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as Created_Moment,
            1                       as Currency_Rate,
            1                       as Currency_Rate_Month,
            'AUD'                   as Source_Currency,
            'AUD'                   as Target_Currency,
            'Average'               as Currency_Rate_Type,
            '1900'                  as Currency_Rate_Year,
            '2022 - YE Jun'         as Financial_Year,
            'stg_workday_exchange_rates'     as record_source

        ORDER BY Source_Currency, Target_Currency, CURRENCY_RATE_TIMESTAMP
    ),

    effective_dates as (
        select
            *,
            case 
                when 
                    currency_rate_type = 'Average' then date_trunc('month', currency_rate_timestamp)
                        -- we do this because the average for the month is calculated and entered into workday as the last day of the month
                        -- we want to have a range from the start of the month to the end of the month for all transactions in the month
                        -- by setting it to the first of the month with date_trunc , we can leave the effective_from and to dates
                        -- caclulated in the next view untouched
                else
                    currency_rate_timestamp
            end                     as effective_from,
            current_timestamp()     as load_date_time
        from 
            default_exchange_rate_union

    ),

    ranked_rows as (
        --rank rows to identify duplicate exchange rate and only select the first one
        select
            *,
            concat_ws('|', Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
                           Source_Currency, 
                           Target_Currency, 
                           Currency_Rate_Type) AS exchange_rates_bk,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
                                            Source_Currency,
                                            Target_Currency,
                                            Currency_Rate_Type
                                            ORDER BY Created_Moment DESC
                                            ) AS row_num
        from
            effective_dates    
    ),    

    final as (
        select
            ranked_rows.exchange_rates_bk,
            ranked_rows.Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
            ranked_rows.Currency_Rate,
            ranked_rows.Currency_Rate_Month,
            ranked_rows.Source_Currency,
            ranked_rows.Target_Currency,
            ranked_rows.Currency_Rate_Type,
            ranked_rows.Currency_Rate_Year,
            ranked_rows.Financial_Year,
            ranked_rows.Effective_From,
            ranked_rows.load_date_time,
            ranked_rows.record_source,
            dateadd( 
                second, 
                -1, 
                ifnull( 
                    lead( effective_from ) 
                        OVER (  
                            PARTITION BY currency_rate_type, source_currency, target_currency ORDER BY effective_from 
                            ) , 
                    to_timestamp('2900-12-31 00:00:00 ') 
                    ) 
                )                   as effective_to
        from
            ranked_rows
        where row_num = 1            
    )
select
    *
from 
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__journal_li.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Journal Line data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Journal_Lines**
      It provides a list Journal Entries and their corresponding Business Concepts
      The actuals provided are mainly for Forecasting, however Costs could be added to the filter of the report if needed in future
model.cr_project.stg_workday__journal_li.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_JOURNAL_LINES REFRESH;",
) }}

WITH
    journal_lines AS (
        SELECT
            
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                                    as Status,
            f.value:Intercompany_Initiating_Company::varchar(100)           as Intercompany_Initiating_Company,
            f.value:Ledger::varchar(100)                                    as Ledger,
            f.value:Ledger_Account::varchar(100)                            as account,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',1)::varchar(100)          as account_bk,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',-1)::varchar(100)         as account_name,
            f.value:Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit::number(20,2)          as Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit,
            f.value:Ledger_Debit_Amount::number(20,2)                       as Ledger_Debit_Amount,
            f.value:Ledger_Credit_Amount::number(20,2)                      as Ledger_Credit_Amount,
            f.value:Journal::varchar(1000)                                  as Journal,
            f.value:Journal_Number::varchar(100)                            as Journal_Number,
            IFNULL(f.value:Journal_Number, f.value:Journal)::varchar(1000)  as Journal_BK,
            f.value:Source::varchar(100)                                    as Source,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::varchar(100)                           as Accounting_Date,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::date                                   as date_bk,

            f.value:Line_Memo::string Line_Memo,
            f.value:Match_ID::varchar(100) Match_ID,
            -- sales item
                f.value:Sales_Item::varchar(100)                        as Sales_Item,
                f.value:Sales_Item_ID::varchar(100)                     as sales_item_bk,
            -- revenue category
                f.value:Revenue_Category::varchar(100)                  as Revenue_Category,
                f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(150)               as revenue_category_bk,
            
            f.value:Currency::varchar(100)                              as Currency,
            -- company
                f.value:Company::varchar(100)                           as Company,
                f.value:Company_ID::varchar(100)                        as company_bk,
            -- cost center
                f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(100)                    as Cost_Center_bk,
                f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(100)                       as cost_center,
                f.value:Cost_Center_Hierarchies::varchar(100)           as Cost_Center_Hierarchies,
            -- project
                ifnull(upper(f.value:Project_ID),'ghost')::varchar(100) as project_bk,
                f.value:Project::varchar(150)                           as Project,
                f.value:Project_Week::varchar(100)                      as Project_Week,
            --
                f.value:Customer_ID::varchar(100)                       as client_ID,
                f.value:Customer::varchar(100)                          as client,
            -- Region
                f.value:Region_ID::varchar(100)                         as region_bk,
                f.value:Region::varchar(100)                            as region,
            -- practice
                f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(100)                       as practice_bk,
                f.value:Practice::varchar(100)                          as practice,

            f.value:Worktags::varchar(1000)                             as Worktags,
            f.value:Contract_Lines::varchar(1000)                       as Contract_Lines,

            f.value:External_Reference_ID::string                 as External_Reference_ID,
            -- spend category
                f.value:Spend_Category_ID::varchar(100)                 as spend_category_bk,
                f.value:Spend_Category::varchar(100)                    as Spend_Category,
            
            ifnull(f.value:Revenue_Category_ID,
                    f.value:Spend_Category_ID)::varchar(100)            as Category_BK,
            f.value:Last_Updated_Moment::varchar(100)                   as Last_Updated_Moment,
            /*
            */
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                             as record_source
        from 
            {{ source('workday', 'ext_journal_lines') }}, 
            table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    final AS (
        select  
            concat_ws('|',
                Project_BK,
                Journal_BK,
                Category_BK,
                Row_Number() Over
                        (Partition By 
                            Project_BK,
                            Journal_BK,
                            Category_BK
                        Order By
                            Project_BK,
                            Journal_BK,
                            Category_BK,
                            Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit
                        )
                    )::varchar(1000)                                    as Journal_Line_BK,
            *,                        
            date_trunc('MONTH', date_bk)                                as month_start_date,
	        replace(client_id,'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')::varchar(100)         as client_bk,
	        position('SFDC_Acct_ID_',client_id)                         as client_salesforce_position,
            current_timestamp                                           as load_date_time
        from
            journal_lines
    )
select
    *
from
    final

    It combines data from both VERSENT_PTY_LTD and VERSENT_GROUP_PTY_LTD, providing a complete dataset for project cost rate.

                cast('landing_workday.stg_workday__project_cost_rate_versent_pty_ltd' as TEXT) as _dbt_source_relation,

                   This star is only output during dbt compile, and exists to keep SQLFluff happy. */

                    cast("PROJECT_COST_RATE_BK" as character varying(1000)) as "PROJECT_COST_RATE_BK" ,

model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.name: stg_workday__project_resource_forecast
model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.description:
This view obtains Forecasting information for Workday Projects, along with who these hours are assigned to via the INT003_Extract_Project_Resources_Forecast custom Workday Report.
    The main information provided via this is:
    Forecasted Hours
    Project Code
    Workday Assigned to these hours
    Contract_Billing_Rate of the Worker in this Specific Project (The worker may charge higher or lower than their ususal rate)
    Project_Role_Cost_Rate which represents the cost rate associated with a given project role. 

    These Forecasted hours and Contract_Billing_Rate can then inform either a Professional Services - Time & Materials project, or just Forecasted hours for a Professional Services - Fixed Price project,

                f.value:Project_Role_ID::varchar(200)                       as Project_Role_ID,

                f.value:Time_Unit_of_Effort::varchar(100)                   as Time_Unit_of_Effort,

                f.value:Project_Role_Requirements::varchar(500)             as Project_Role_Requirements,
                f.value:Contract_Billing_Rate::varchar(50)                  as Contract_Billing_Rate,
                f.value:Hourly_Project_Role_Cost_Rate::varchar(100)         as Project_Role_Cost_Rate,
                f.value:Worker::varchar(500)                                as Worker,

                f.value:Worker_ID::varchar(50)                              as employee_bk,

        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_project_resource_forecast') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    final as (
        select
            *,
            CONCAT(RESOURCE_FORECAST_LINE_ID, '/', DATE_OF_FORECAST)                        as forecasted_hours_bk,
            to_timestamp(regexp_substr(record_source, '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}'))              as cost_rate_as_of,
            to_timestamp_ltz(current_timestamp)                                             as load_date_time
        from
            forecast_lines
        where
            Primary_Project_Hierarchy not in ('Internal: Admin', 'Internal: Innovation')    
    )

model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.name: stg_workday__project_revenue
model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Journal Line data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Journal_Lines_NoFilter**
      It provides a list Journal Entries and their corresponding Business Concepts which sepcifally for the Project Revenue
      This report is used to created for the Project Revenue, mainly focusing on the Customer Invoices and Revenue Recognition

      AS per 18th February, now the report also include CANCELED journal lines to be able to update the fact_project_revenue to exclude the canceled journal lines
      and the project_revenue_bk has been changed to using Wokrday Journal Line Id which is unique for each journal line id
model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_JOURNAL_LINES_NOFILTER REFRESH;",
) }}

WITH
    project_revenue AS (
        SELECT
            f.value:Journal_Line_workdayID::varchar(200)                     as Journal_Line_ID,
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                                    as Status,
            f.value:Intercompany_Initiating_Company::varchar(100)           as Intercompany_Initiating_Company,
            f.value:Ledger::varchar(100)                                    as Ledger,
            f.value:Ledger_Account::varchar(100)                            as account,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',1)::varchar(100)          as account_bk,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',-1)::varchar(100)         as account_name,
            f.value:Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit::number(20,2)          as Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit,
            f.value:Ledger_Debit_Amount::number(20,2)                       as Ledger_Debit_Amount,
            f.value:Ledger_Credit_Amount::number(20,2)                      as Ledger_Credit_Amount,
            f.value:Journal::varchar(1000)                                  as Journal_Name,
            f.value:Journal_Number::varchar(100)                            as Journal_Number,
            IFNULL(f.value:Journal_Number, f.value:Journal)::varchar(1000)  as Journal_BK,
            f.value:Source::varchar(100)                                    as Source,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::varchar(100)                           as Accounting_Date,

model.cr_project.stg_workday__projects.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Project data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Projects**
    The API data regarding the projects in Workday.
    Some of these fields are discrete and provide Start and End dates etc
    It also provides many mappings to other Workday Business Concepts such as Region, Cost Center, Primary_Project_Hierarchy and more
    The model feeds into the hore hub_project Datavault model and into dim_project
model.cr_project.stg_workday__projects.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PROJECTS REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
    stg as (
        SELECT 
                -- 2022-07-06 - TOM WALLER - https://versent.atlassian.net/browse/EAG-1912, 
                --Added RTRIM INACTIVE as inactive Workday projects append this string to Project Ids. 
                -- this needs to be removed to normalize the project_bk
                -- Moved Toms comments here - TN
                upper(
                    REPLACE(
                        f.value:Project_ID::varchar(50), 
                        ' (Inactive)', 
                        ''
                        )
                    )::varchar(200)                                     as project_bk,
                f.value:ID::varchar(300)                                as ID,
                f.value:Project_State::varchar(200)                     as Project_State,
                f.value:Primary_Project_Hierarchy::varchar(200)         as Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
                f.value:Billable::varchar(10)                           as Billable,
                f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(200)                       as Cost_Center,
                f.value:Practice::varchar(50)                           as practice_name,
                f.value:Start_Date::date                                as Start_Date,
                f.value:End_Date::date                                  as End_Date,
                f.value:Salesforce_ID::varchar(200)                     as Salesforce_ID,
                f.value:Customer_Reference_ID::varchar(200)             as Customer_Reference_ID,
                f.value:Customer_ID::varchar(200)                       as Customer_ID,
                f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(50)                     as cost_center_bk,
                f.value:Company_ID::varchar(100)                        as company_bk,
                f.value:Company::varchar(200)                           as Company,
                f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(50)                        as practice_bk,
                f.value:Region_ID::varchar(50)                          as region_bk,
                f.value:Project::varchar(500)                           as Project,
                f.value:Project_Description::string                     as Project_Description,
                f.value:Project_Groups::varchar(1000)                   as Project_Groups,                
                f.value:Project_Region::varchar(200)                    as Project_Region,
                f.value:Project_Owner::varchar(200)                     as Project_Owner,
                f.value:Billable_Amount::varchar(200)                   as Billable_Amount,
                f.value:Contract_Lines::string                          as Contract_Lines,
                f.value:Contract_Lines_group::string                    as Contract_Lines_group,
                NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(UPPER(f.value:Project_Description::string), 
                                'PO NUMBER:', 2), 'DISCOUNT:', 1), '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', ''), '')::varchar(200)  as PO_Number,
                TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(f.value:Project_Description, 
                                'Discount:\\s*([0-9.]+)%', 1, 1, 'i', 1), 38, 2)               as Discount,
                TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(f.value:Project_Description, 
                                'Target Profitability:\\s*([0-9.]+)%', 1, 1, 'i', 1), 38, 2)   as Target_Profitability,                                 
                METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(250)                         as record_source,
                current_timestamp()                                     as load_date_time
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_projects') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
        ),
    final as (
        select 
            project_bk,
            ID,
            Project_State,
            Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
            Billable,
            Cost_Center,
            practice_name,
            Start_Date,
            End_Date,
            Salesforce_ID,
            Customer_Reference_ID,
            Customer_ID,
            cost_center_bk,
            company_bk,
            Company,
            practice_bk,
            region_bk,
            Project,
            Project_Description,
            Project_Groups,
            Project_Region,
            Project_Owner,
            Billable_Amount,
            Contract_Lines,
            Contract_Lines_group,
            PO_Number,            
            Discount,
            Target_Profitability,                    
            CASE 
                WHEN SALESFORCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'ghost' 
                ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(SALESFORCE_ID,'SFDC_Opp_ID_',''),'SFID_Opp_ID_','') END    as OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            date_trunc('month', start_date)                                                     as start_date_month,
            date_trunc('month', end_date)                                                       as end_date_month,
            record_source,
            load_date_time
        from stg
    )
select 
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__public_hol.description: This model extracts raw Public Holiday JSON data from Workday's Public Holiday custom report
model.cr_project.stg_workday__public_hol.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS REFRESH;",
) }}

with
    report_entry as (
        select 
            f.value:Location::varchar(500)                  as Location,
            f.value:Location_Hierarchy::varchar(500)        as Location_Hierarchy,
            f.value:Calendar_Events_group                   as Calendar_Events_group,
            METADATA$FILENAME                               as record_source
        from 
            {{ source('workday', 'ext_public_holidays') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    public_holiday_lines as (
        select  
            ifnull(report_entry.Location,report_entry.Location_Hierarchy)   as Location,
            report_entry.Location_Hierarchy,
            f.value:Holiday::varchar(1000)                                  as Holiday,
            f.value:Start_Date::varchar(50)                                 as Start_Date,
            f.value:End_Date::varchar(50)                                   as End_Date,
            report_entry.record_source
        from 
            report_entry, table(flatten(Calendar_Events_group)) f
    ),
    -- handle duplicate holiday records
    unique_rows as (
        select  
            TO_DATE(public_holiday_lines.Start_Date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')      as Date_BK,
            case  -- workaround until the data from Workday is fixed
                when public_holiday_lines.Location = 'Holiday Calendar for Singapore (Manilla)' then 'Manila'
                else public_holiday_lines.Location 
            end                                                         as Location,
            public_holiday_lines.Location_Hierarchy,
            MAX(public_holiday_lines.Holiday)                           as Holiday,
            public_holiday_lines.Start_Date,
            public_holiday_lines.End_Date,
            public_holiday_lines.record_source
        from
            public_holiday_lines
        group by all
    ),
    final as (
        select
            concat_ws('|',
                    Location,
                    Date_BK)        as Public_Holiday_BK,
            Date_BK,
            Location,
            Location_Hierarchy,
            Holiday,
            Start_Date,
            End_Date,
            Record_Source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP       as Load_Date_Time
        from
            unique_rows 
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__revenue_ca.description: This model ingests and standardises the field names of Revenue Category data provided by the Workday API **INT003_Revenue_Categories**
model.cr_project.stg_workday__revenue_ca.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_REVENUE_CATEGORIES REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
    revenue_categories as (
        select  
            f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(100)               as Revenue_Category_BK,
            f.value:Revenue_Category_Name::varchar(100)             as Revenue_Category_Name,
            f.value:Revenue_Category_Hierarchies_group              as Hierarchies_Group,
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(200)                         as Record_Source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_revenue_categories') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    hierarchies_group as (
        select
            revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_BK,
            revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_Name,
            f.value:Parent_Revenue_Category_Hierarchy::varchar(100) as Parent_Level,
            f.value:Revenue_Category_Hierarchy::varchar(100)        as Revenue_Group,
            revenue_categories.Record_Source            
        from
            revenue_categories, table(flatten(Hierarchies_Group)) f
    ),
    final as (
        select
            revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_BK,
            revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_Name,
            ifnull(hierarchies_group.Parent_Level,'ghost')          as Parent_Level,
            ifnull(hierarchies_group.Revenue_Group,'ghost')         as Revenue_Group,
            revenue_categories.Record_Source,
            current_timestamp()                                     as Load_Date_Time
        from
            revenue_categories
        left join
            hierarchies_group
                on revenue_categories.revenue_category_bk = hierarchies_group.revenue_category_bk
        -- This QUALIFY clause filters the result set to include only the first row for each unique
        -- Revenue_Category_BK, as determined by the row_number() window function. The rows are ordered
        -- within each partition by Revenue_Category_Name, ensuring that only the row with the lowest
        -- Revenue_Category_Name for each Revenue_Category_BK is retained.
        qualify 
            row_number() over (
                partition by 
                    revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_BK 
                order by 
                    revenue_categories.Revenue_Category_Name) = 1 
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.name: stg_workday_customer_contract_lines
model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Contract Line data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Find_Customer_Contract_Lines**
    The data is currently used to obtain a Workday Projects Deal Value, as this is a sum of all contract lines, 
    as opposed to Salesforces SOW showing a project  value via  a distinct field
    The contract lines can also be used in the future for calculating PingCloud forecasting, once Revenue Recognition Lines are obtained
    This is due to PingCloud having a single Contract Line for all PingCloud Opportunities as a parent, and a Revenue Recognition Schedule for each client
model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINES REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
flatten as (
    select
        -- Concept IDs
        f.value:Contract_ID::varchar(50)                                            AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_BK,
        f.value:Contract::varchar(200)                                              AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NAME,
        f.value:Contract_Line::varchar(200)                                         AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINE_BK,
        f.value:Contract_Line_ID::varchar(200)                                      AS CONTRACT_LINE_ID,
        f.value:Customer_Contract_Line_Number::number                               AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINE_NUMBER,

        -- Concept fields   
        UPPER(f.value:Line_Status::varchar(200))                                    AS LINE_STATUS,
        f.value:Billing_Schedule_ID::varchar(200)                                   AS BILLING_SCHEDULE_ID,
        f.value:Revenue_Recognition_Schedule_ID::varchar(200)                       AS REVENUE_RECOGNITION_SCHEDULE_ID,
        UPPER(f.value:Contract_Line_Type::varchar(200))                             AS CONTRACT_LINE_TYPE,
        UPPER(f.value:Project_Transaction_Source::varchar(200))                     AS PROJECT_TRANSACTION_SOURCE,
        UPPER(f.value:Revenue_Treatment::varchar(200))                              AS REVENUE_TREATMENT,

        -- Relationship BKs

        UPPER(f.value:Billable_Project_group[0].Billable_Project_ID::varchar(50))   AS PROJECT_BK,
        f.value:Currency::varchar(10)                                               AS CURRENCY,
        f.value:Region_ID::varchar(50)                                              AS REGION_BK,
        f.value:Cost_Centre_ID::varchar(50)                                         AS COST_CENTER_BK,
        f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(50)                                            AS PRACTICE_BK,
        f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(50)                                    AS REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Bill_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS BILL_CUSTOMER_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Sold_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS SOLD_CUSTOMER_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Sold_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS CLIENT_BK,

        -- Names
        f.value:Company::varchar(50)                                                AS COMPANY_NAME,
        f.value:Billable_Project::varchar(200)                                      AS BILLABLE_PROJECT,
        f.value:Renewable::boolean                                                  AS RENEWABLE,
        f.value:Cost_Centre_Hierarchies::varchar(50)                                AS COST_CENTRE_HIERARCHIES,
        f.value:Revenue_Category::varchar(50)                                       AS REVENUE_CATEGORY,
        f.value:Practice::varchar(50)                                               AS PRACTICE,
        f.value:Cost_Centre::varchar(50)                                            AS COST_CENTRE,
        f.value:New_Business::boolean                                               AS NEW_BUSINESS,
        f.value:Billing_Schedule::varchar(300)                                      AS BILLING_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:"Sold-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS SOLD_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,
        f.value:"Bill-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,
        f.value:Billable_Project_group                                              AS BILLABLE_PROJECT_GROUP,
        f.value:Worktags::varchar(200)                                              AS WORKTAGS,
        f.value:Revenue_Recognition_Schedule::varchar(200)                          AS REVENUE_RECOGNITION_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:Region::varchar(50)                                                 AS REGION,

        -- Amounts
        f.value:Line_Amount::number(20,2)                                           AS AMOUNT,
        f.value:Recognized_Deferred_Revenue::number(20,2)                           AS RECOGNIZED_DEFERRED_REVENUE,
        f.value:Scheduled_Deferred_Revenue_To_Recognize::number(20,2)               AS SCHEDULED_DEFERRED_REVENUE_TO_RECOGNIZE,
        f.value:Adjustment_Amount::number(20,2)                                     AS ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Billed_Amount::number(20,2)                                         AS BILLED_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Revenue_Override_Amount::number(20,2)                               AS REVENUE_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Deferred_Revenue_Balance::number(20,2)                              AS DEFERRED_REVENUE_BALANCE,

        current_date()                                                              AS DATE_BK,
        current_timestamp()                                                         AS LOAD_DATE_TIME,
        METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                                             AS RECORD_SOURCE
        
    from {{ source('workday', 'ext_customer_contract_lines') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
) ,
active_lines as (
    select
        *
    from
        flatten
    where
        -- TOM WALLER - EAG-2170
        -- Filtering out line_status of cancelled. Explicitly allowing these stauses though incase others are in Workday that we don't know about
        line_status in ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETE')
),
final as (
    select 
        *
    from
        active_lines
)
select 
    *
from
    final

This model ingests and standardises the field names of Project Plan data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Extract_Project_Resources**
    Workday Project Plans are a more details version of a Project Forecast and are used closer to a projects start date
    At this time, the Project Forecast is used as it is used earlier than the plan, allowing for more forecasting,albeit slightly more innacuratly
    This data is currently used for Project Roles
model.cr_project.stg_workday_project_res.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_PLAN REFRESH;",
) }}

with 
    project_resource_plan as (
        select 
        f.value:Project_Resource_Plan_ReferenceID::varchar(200)                    as Project_Resource_Plan_ReferenceID,
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')      as Project_ID,
        f.value:Project_Role::varchar(200)                                          as Project_Role,
        IFNULL(f.value:End_Date::varchar(50)   ,'1900-01-01')                       as End_Date,
        IFNULL(f.value:Project_Role_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')                       as Project_Role_ID,
        f.value:Project::varchar(250)                                               as Project,
        f.value:Percent_Allocation::varchar(10)                                     as Percent_Allocation,
        f.value:Time_Unit_of_Effort::varchar(200)                                   as Time_Unit_of_Effort,
        f.value:Project_Resource_Plan::varchar(500)                                 as Project_Resource_Plan,
        f.value:Workers::string                                                     as Worker,
        f.value:Contract_Billing_Rate::varchar(50)                                  as Contract_Billing_Rate,
        IFNULL(f.value:Start_Date::varchar(50),'1900-01-01')                        as Start_Date,
        f.value:Project_Resource_Plan1::varchar(500)                                as Project_Resource_Plan1,
        f.value:Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate::varchar(50)                                as Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate,
        f.value:Resource_Type::varchar(50)                                          as Resource_Type,
        f.value:Unnamed_Resource::string                                            as Unnamed_Resource,
        f.value:Contract_Rate_Currency::varchar(200)                                as Contract_Rate_Currency,
        -- Project and workers come as an array via the API, however only 1 can be selected in the UI.
        -- Therefore get the first in the array
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Currency::varchar(200)                as Project_Currency,
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Salesforce_ID::varchar(200)           as Project_Salesforce_ID,
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Primary_Project_Hierarchy::varchar(200)       as Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Workers_group, 0):Employee_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')     as Worker_ID,
        f.value:To_Be_Hired::varchar(50)                                            as To_Be_Hired,
        f.value:Job_Requisition::varchar(200)                                       as Job_Requisition,
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Owner::varchar(200),'ghost')   as Project_Owner,
        METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(200)                                             as Record_Source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_project_resource_plan') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
        
    )
select 
        Project_Resource_Plan_ReferenceID  as Resource_Plan_BK,            
        Upper(Project_ID)                   as Project_BK,
        Project_Role,
        End_Date,
        Project_Role_ID,
        Project,
        Percent_Allocation,
        Time_Unit_of_Effort,
        Project_Resource_Plan,
        Worker,
        Contract_Billing_Rate,
        Start_Date,
        Project_Resource_Plan1,
        Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate,
        Resource_Type,
        Unnamed_Resource,
        Contract_Rate_Currency,
        Project_Currency,
        Project_Salesforce_ID,
        Worker_ID,
        To_Be_Hired,
        Job_Requisition,
        Project_Owner,
        Record_Source,
        Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
        CURRENT_DATE                            as Plan_Date,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP                       as Load_Date_time
from 
    project_resource_plan
    -- excluded as requested in EAG-2702
where Primary_Project_Hierarchy not in ('Internal: Admin', 'Internal: Innovation','Internal: Transformation')

model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.name: stg_workday_time_block_audit
model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Time Sheet data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Time_Block_Audit**
    This data provides real timesheet data clocked against a Project for a worker
    The data is not currently used, but could be for Forecast Ultisiation.

    As 23 September 2025, 
    The timesheet bk cahnges to Time_Block_ID as it represent uniqueness on each entry of the timesheet to avoid any duplication where there are 
    two time entries submitted on a day working on the same project with the same task code or with the delere and recreated entries with same attributes.
    Use the file name with the time stamp for the load_date_time to represent the uqnieu laod date time of the record in case of changes ot any enties.

    As 21st October 2025, 
    The column that represent the status of the timesheet changes to "Status" from "Reported_Time_Block_Historical_Status" inside the nested "Reported_Time_Block_History_group"
    It will show the most recent status of the time block audit and handle the Automatic Approval Status
model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_TIME_BLOCK_AUDIT REFRESH;"
) }}

with
    time_block_audit_line as (
        select         
            IFNULL(f.value:Task_Code,'ghost')::varchar(1000)    as Task_Code,
            IFNULL(f.value:Worker_ID,'ghost')::varchar(50)      as Employee_BK,
            IFNULL(f.value:Project_ID,'ghost')::varchar(50)     as Project_BK,
            f.value:Time_Block_ID::varchar(100)                 as Time_Block_ID,
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                        as Status,            
            f.value:Worker_Location::varchar(50)                as Worker_Location,
            f.value:Supervisory_Organisation::varchar(100)      as Supervisory_Organisation,
            f.value:Position::varchar(500)                      as Position,
            f.value:Billing_Status::varchar(50)                 as Billing_Status,
            f.value:Billable_Rate::varchar(50)                  as Billable_Rate,
            f.value:Invoice_Number::varchar(100)                as Invoice_Number,
            f.value:Revenue_Status::varchar(100)                as Revenue_Status,
            f.value:Total_Hours__Time_Tracking::number(20,2)    as Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,
            f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(100)                   as Cost_Center,
            f.value:Practice::varchar(100)                      as Practice,
            f.value:Time_Block::varchar(100)                    as Time_Block,
            f.value:Billable_Hours::number(20,2)                as Billable_Hours,
            f.value:Project_Role::varchar(500)                  as Project_Role,
            f.value:Project::string                             as Project,
            f.value:Calculated_Date::Date                       as Calculated_Date,
            f.value:Region::varchar(50)                         as Region,
            f.value:Worker::varchar(100)                        as Worker,
            f.value:Calculation_Tags::varchar(100)              as Calculation_Tags,
            f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(50)                 as Cost_Center_BK,
            f.value:Customer_Billing_Currency::varchar(20)      as Billing_Currency,            
            f.value:Comment::string                             as Comment,
            f.value:Is_Deleted::boolean                         as Is_Deleted,
            f.value:Reported_Time_Block_History_group           as Reported_Time_Block_History_group,
            COALESCE(f.value:Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group,
                    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())                          as Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group,
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(200)                     as record_source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_time_block_audit') }}, table(flatten(value)) f  
        where f.value:Status in ('Approved')                           
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            t.Time_Block_ID,
            t.Status,
            t.Task_Code,
            t.Worker_Location,                                          
            t.Supervisory_Organisation,                                    
            t.Position,                                                   
            t.Billable_Rate,    
            t.Billing_Status,                                                                             
            t.Cost_Center,                                                                                
            t.Time_Block,                                                    
            t.Project,                                                       
            t.Calculated_Date,                                                 
            t.Region,                                                          
            t.Worker,     
            t.Project_BK, 
            t.Employee_BK,               
            IFNULL(t.Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,0)                                            as Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,                                    
            IFNULL(t.Practice,'ghost')                                                        as Practice,            
            IFNULL(t.Billable_Hours,0)                                                        as Billable_Hours,                                                 
            IFNULL(t.Project_Role, 'ghost')                                                   as Project_Role,                                                               
            IFNULL(t.Cost_Center_BK,'ghost')                                                  as Cost_Center_BK,
            IFNULL(t.Invoice_Number, 'ghost')                                                 as Invoice_Number,
            IFNULL(t.Revenue_Status, 'ghost')                                                 as Revenue_Status,
            t.Calculation_Tags,              
            t.Billing_Currency,                                  
            t.Comment,
            t.Is_Deleted,                                         
            f1.value:Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date::Date                                as Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
            f1.value:Modified_By::varchar(100)                                                as Modified_By,
            f1.value:Modified_Moment::string                                                  as Modified_Moment,
            f1.value:Reported_Quantity::varchar(50)                                           as Reported_Quantity,
            f1.value:Source::varchar(100)                                                     as Source,
            f1.value:Time_Entry_Code::varchar(100)                                            as Time_Entry_Code,
            COALESCE(f2.value:Rate_To_Bill::varchar(50), NULL)                                as Override_Rate,
            record_source                                                                     as Record_Source,
            TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(
                REPLACE( 
                    REGEXP_SUBSTR(record_source, '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}'),
                        '-', ' '), 
                            'YYYY MM DD HH MI SS')                                            as Load_Date_Time
        from time_block_audit_line t
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Reported_Time_Block_History_group) f1
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group, outer => true) f2
        -- filtered by 'Approved' statuses and added row number to handle instances of multiple approval in the reported_time_block_history_group
        -- final select query will select row_num = 1 which is the latest 'Approved' instance
        qualify Row_Number() Over (
            Partition By 
                t.Time_Block_ID
            Order By 
                f1.value:Modified_Moment DESC) = 1
    )
select   
        Time_Block_ID as Timesheet_BK,
        Task_Code,
        Worker_Location,   
        Supervisory_Organisation,
        Position,
        Billable_Rate,
        Override_Rate,
        Billing_Status,
        Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,
        Upper(Project_BK)                   as Project_BK,
        Cost_Center,
        Practice,
        Time_Block,
        Billable_Hours,
        Invoice_Number,
        Revenue_Status,
        Billing_Currency,
        Project_Role,
        Project,
        Calculated_Date,
        Region,
        Worker,
        Employee_BK,
        Calculation_Tags,
        Cost_Center_BK,
        Comment,
        Is_Deleted,
        Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
        Status as Timesheet_Status,
        Modified_By,
        Modified_Moment,
        Reported_Quantity,
        Source,
        Time_Entry_Code,
        Record_Source,
        Load_Date_time     
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday_workers.name: stg_workday_workers
model.cr_project.stg_workday_workers.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Worker data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Workers**
    It allows for a distinct list of all Workers in Workday, is of they arent assigned to a Project
model.cr_project.stg_workday_workers.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_WORKERS REFRESH;",
) }}
with
    ext as (
        select 
            f.value:Employee_ID::varchar(50)                    as Employee_bk,
            f.value:First_Name::varchar(50)                     as First_Name,
            f.value:Last_Name::varchar(50)                      as Last_Name,
            f.value:Work_Email::varchar(50)                     as Work_Email,
            f.value:Worker_Type::varchar(50)                    as Worker_Type,
            f.value:Worker_SubType::varchar(50)                 as Worker_SubType,

            f.value:Location_ID::varchar(50)                    as Location_ID,
            f.value:Location::varchar(50)                       as Location,
            f.value:Location_Hierarchies::varchar(50)           as Location_Hierarchies,
            f.value:Region_ID::varchar(50)                      as Region_ID,
            f.value:Region::varchar(50)                         as Region,

            f.value:Hire_Date::date                             as Hire_Date,
            f.value:Original_Hire_Date::date                    as Original_Hire_Date,
            f.value:Termination_Date::date                      as Termination_Date,
            f.value:Most_Recent_Approved_Termination_Date::date as Recent_Termination_Date,

            f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(50)                 as Cost_Center_ID,
            f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(50)                    as Cost_Center,
            f.value:Cost_Center_Hierarchy::varchar(50)          as Cost_Center_Hierarchy,
            f.value:Function_ID::varchar(50)                    as Function_ID,
            f.value:Function::varchar(50)                       as Function,
            f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(50)                    as Practice_ID,
            f.value:Practice::varchar(50)                       as Practice,
            f.value:FTE::varchar(50)                            as FTE,
            f.value:Scheduled_Weekly_Hours::varchar(50)         as Scheduled_Weekly_Hours,
            f.value:Default_Weekly_Hours::varchar(50)           as Default_Weekly_Hours,
            f.value:Business_Title::varchar(200)                as Business_Title,
            f.value:Job_Profile::varchar(200)                   as Job_Profile,
            f.value:Worker_Has_Future_Termination_Event::boolean    as Has_Future_Termination_Event,
            f.value:"Supervisory_Organisation_-_Hierarchy"::string as Supervisory_Organisation_Hierarchy,
            METADATA$FILENAME                                   as record_source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_workers') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    final as (
        select 
            employee_bk,
            first_name,
            last_name,
            work_email,
            worker_type,
            worker_subtype,
            region_id,
            hire_date,
            cost_center_id,
            {{ default_to_ghost_if_bk_null('function') }},
            practice,
            ifnull(default_weekly_hours,38) / 5 as working_hours,
            location,
            location_hierarchies,
            fte,
            scheduled_weekly_hours,
            default_weekly_hours,
            termination_date,
            business_title,
            job_profile,
            supervisory_organisation_hierarchy,
            recent_termination_date,
            has_future_termination_event,
            record_source
        from
            ext

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW OVERWATCH_LANDING_DB.XERO.SINGAPORE_CREDIT_NOTES AS
with 
  CreditNotesLineItems AS (
    select
      METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(150)                 as record_source,
      creditNote.value:CreditNoteID::varchar(50)      as document_id,
      creditNote.value:CreditNoteNumber::String       as CreditNoteNumber,
      creditNote.value:Type::varchar(50)              as type, 
      creditNote.value:Contact.Name::String           as Customer,
      creditNote.value:DateString::Date               as date_bk,
      creditNote.value:Status::varchar(50)            as Status,
      flatdata.value:Description::String              as description,
      Lower(flatdata.value:AccountCode::String)       as account_code,
      flatdata.value:Tracking[0].Option::String       as Division,
      flatdata.value:Tracking[1].Option::String       as Region,
      creditNote.value:LineAmountTypes::varchar(50)   as line_amount_types,
      flatdata.value:LineAmount :: Double             as LineAmount,
      flatdata.value:TaxAmount::Double                as TaxAmount,
      creditNote.value:LineAmountTypes::String        as Taxed,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyCode::String           as Currency,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyRate::Double           as ConversionValue,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyRate::Double           as CurrencyRate,
      creditNote.value:UpdatedDateUTC::Datetime       as updatedDate,
      creditNote.value:_sdc_batched_at::Datetime      as batchDate
    FROM 
      {{ source('xero', 'ext_singapore_credit_notes_json') }}  creditNote,
      lateral flatten(input => parse_json(creditNote.value:LineItems)) flatdata
  ),
  final as (
    select
      CreditNotesLineItems.*,
      case
        when account_code IN ('201','201b','202','202a','204','205','206','207','209b','210b') then 'LICENSING REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%201%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%202%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%204%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%205%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%206%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%207%' 
          then 'LICENSING REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%216%' AND 
          (
          SUBSTRING(
            description,
            CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
            (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
          ) :: String) = '' 
          then 'AWS REVENUE COST'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%260%' then 'STAX SALES REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%261%' then 'OTHER REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%217%' AND (SUBSTRING(description,
      CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
      (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
      ) :: String) = '' then 'REFERRAL FEE INCOME'
      else
        SUBSTRING(
          description,
          CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
          (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
        ) :: String end
        as project_bk,
      case
        when 
          type = 'ACCRECCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types = 'Inclusive' 
          then
            ((LineAmount)-(TaxAmount))/(CurrencyRate)*-1
        when 
          type = 'ACCRECCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
          (LineAmount)/(CurrencyRate)*-1
        when 
          type= 'ACCPAYCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types = 'Inclusive' then
          (((LineAmount)-(TaxAmount))/(CurrencyRate))
        when 
          type = 'ACCPAYCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
          ((LineAmount)/(CurrencyRate))
      end
      as revenue_amount
    from
      CreditNotesLineItems
    where 
      status in ('PAID','AUTHORISED')
  )
select 
  distinct 
  final.*
from 
  final

    from
      {{ source('xero', 'ext_versent_invoices_json') }} invoice,
      lateral flatten(input => parse_json(invoice.value:LineItems)) flatdata
  ),
  last_record as (
    select
        lineitemid,
        document_id,
        max(updateddate) as max_date,
        max(batchDate) as latest_batch
    from
        shred_json
    group by 
        lineitemid,
        document_id,
        lineAmount
  ),
  de_dupe as (
    select
        shred_json.*
    from
        shred_json
        join 
            last_record
            on
                shred_json.lineitemid   = last_record.lineitemid    and
                shred_json.document_id  = last_record.document_id   and
                shred_json.updateddate  = last_record.max_date      and
                shred_json.batchDate    = last_record.latest_batch
    where
        -- Get the right transaction types
            (
                shred_json.Type = 'ACCREC' OR 
                shred_json.Type  = 'ACCPAY'
            ) AND 
            shred_json.Status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'DELETED', 'VOIDED')  
        -- Get the record from the latest batch

  ),
  invoicelineItems AS (

  SELECT
    de_dupe.*,
    {{ default_to_ghost_if_bk_null_no_alias('region_input') }} as region,
    ifnull(
      account_code_prelim, 
      '{{var("ghost_record")}}'

      when de_dupe.account_code_prelim LIKE '%216%' AND

            CHARINDEX('[', de_dupe.Description)+1,
            (CHARINDEX(']', de_dupe.Description) - CHARINDEX('[', de_dupe.Description))-1
        ) :: String) = '' 
        then 'AWS REVENUE COST'
      when de_dupe.account_code_prelim LIKE '%260%' then 'STAX SALES REVENUE'
      when de_dupe.account_code_prelim LIKE '%261%' then 'OTHER REVENUE'
      when 
        de_dupe.account_code_prelim LIKE '%217%' AND 
        (
          SUBSTRING(de_dupe.Description,
          CHARINDEX('[', de_dupe.Description)+1,
          (CHARINDEX(']', de_dupe.Description) - CHARINDEX('[', de_dupe.Description))-1
        ) :: String) = '' then 'REFERRAL FEE INCOME'
      else
        SUBSTRING(
          de_dupe.Description,
          CHARINDEX(
            '[', 
            de_dupe.Description)+1,
            (
              CHARINDEX(
                ']', 
                de_dupe.Description
                ) - 
                CHARINDEX(
                  '[', 
                  de_dupe.Description
                  )
                  )-1
      ) :: varchar(500) end                                      as project_bk,
    case
      when de_dupe.Type = 'ACCREC' AND de_dupe.LineAmountTypes = 'Inclusive' then
        ((de_dupe.LineAmount)-(de_dupe.TaxAmount))/(de_dupe.CurrencyRate)
      when de_dupe.Type = 'ACCREC' AND de_dupe.LineAmountTypes IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
        (de_dupe.LineAmount)/(de_dupe.CurrencyRate)
      when de_dupe.Type = 'ACCPAY' AND de_dupe.LineAmountTypes = 'Inclusive' then
        (((de_dupe.LineAmount)-(de_dupe.TaxAmount))/(de_dupe.CurrencyRate))*-1
      when de_dupe.Type = 'ACCPAY' AND de_dupe.LineAmountTypes IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
        ((de_dupe.LineAmount)/(de_dupe.CurrencyRate))*-1
      else
        0
      end
      as revenue_amount
  FROM 
    de_dupe

  WHERE 

    -- de_dupe.AmountCredited != de_dupe.LineAmount and
    1=1
  ) --now only select the latest line item records to remove duplicates
  SELECT invoicelineItems.*
  FROM invoicelineItems

model.cr_project.stg_xero__versent__paym.raw_code:
with 
   payment as (
    SELECT
      METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(150)                 as record_source,
      payment.value:PaymentID::string                 as document_id,
      payment.value:PaymentType::string as PaymentType,
      payment.value:Invoice.Contact.Name::string as Customer,
      SUBSTRING(
        payment.value:Reference,
        CHARINDEX('[', payment.value:Reference)+1,
        (
          CHARINDEX(']', 
          payment.value:Reference) - CHARINDEX('[', 
          payment.value:Reference)
        )-1
      ) :: String
      as project_bk,
      payment.value:Invoice.InvoiceNumber::string as InvoiceNumber,
      payment.value:Invoice.Type:: String as Type,
      payment.value:Date::Date                        as date_bk,
      payment.value:Status::string                    as Status,
      payment.value:Reference::string as Reference,
      Lower(payment.value:Account.Code)               as account_code,
      payment.value:Account.AccountID::varchar(50)    as account_id,
      case
        when 
          SUBSTRING(
            payment.value:Reference,
            CHARINDEX('[', payment.value:Reference)+1,
            (CHARINDEX(']', payment.value:Reference) - CHARINDEX('[', payment.value:Reference))-1
          ) :: String = 'ANZ-016-CLD-TM' 
          then 'Cloud' 
        else 'NOT PROVIDED' 
      end                                           as Division,
      case
        when 
          SUBSTRING(
            payment.value:Reference,
            CHARINDEX('[', payment.value:Reference)+1,
            (CHARINDEX(']', payment.value:Reference) - CHARINDEX('[', payment.value:Reference))-1
          ) :: String = 'ANZ-016-CLD-TM' then 'North' else 'NOT PROVIDED' 
      end                                                       as Region,
      payment.value:Amount::Double                              as amount,
      payment.value:Invoice.CurrencyCode::string as Currency,
      payment.value:CurrencyRate::Double as ConversionValue,
      case
        when payment.value:PaymentType IN ('ARCREDITPAYMENT','AROVERPAYMENTPAYMENT','ARPREPAYMENTPAYMENT','ACCRECPAYMENT') then payment.value:BankAmount::Double
        when payment.value:PaymentType IN ('APCREDITPAYMENT', 'APPREPAYMENTPAYMENT', 'APOVERPAYMENTPAYMENT', 'ACCPAYPAYMENT') then (payment.value:BankAmount::Double)*-1
        else
          (payment.value:BankAmount::Double)
        end
        as revenue_amount,
      payment.value:UpdatedDateUTC::Datetime as updatedDate,
      payment.value:_sdc_batched_at::Datetime as batchDate
    FROM {{ source('xero','ext_versent_payments_json') }} payment
   )
select * 
from
  payment
where status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'DELETED', 'VOIDED')

# Model: tlnk_project_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
Raw Data Vault transactional link that stores project cost rate assignments, linking employees to projects in specific roles with temporal validity periods.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Immutable transactional link (append-only)
- Captures cost rate assignments with effective date ranges

## Sources & Dependencies
- **Source**: `int_tlnk_project_cost_rate`
- **Related Hubs**: `hub_project`, `hub_account` (employees), `hub_project_role`
- **Downstream**: `bc_project_cost_rate`, `int_project_cost_rate_adjusted`, `fact_time_sheet`

## Key Fields
- `TLNK_PROJECT_COST_RATE_SID`: Primary key (MD5 hash of business keys + temporal fields)
- `RESOURCE_COST_RATE_BK`: Workday Journal Line ID (unique transaction identifier)
- `PROJECT_SID`, `EMPLOYEE_SID`, `PROJECT_ROLE_SID`: Hub references
- `START_DATE`: Cost rate effective start date
- `LOAD_DATE_TIME`: Record load timestamp

# Model: tlnk_standard_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
This t-link model captures the relationship between standard cost rates and their associated business keys in the Data Vault raw layer. It is used to link cost rate information to other relevant entities for historical tracking and integration.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Integrates business keys and cost rate data from the intermediate and/or snapshot models.
- Ensures each link is uniquely identified by the combination of Project_Role_ID and Effective_From.
- Follows Data Vault modeling conventions for t-link structures.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Depends on the intermediate model `int_tlnk_standard_cost_rate` and related Data Vault raw layer models.
- Main source: `int_tlnk_standard_cost_rate`.

## Key Fields
- Project_Role_ID: Business key for the project role.
- Project_Role: Name of the project role.
- Standard_Cost_Rate: Standard cost rate for the project role.
- Effective_From: Date when the cost rate became effective.
- record_source: Source of the record.
- load_date_time: Timestamp when the record was loaded.

## Update Frequency
- Updated as part of the dbt pipeline whenever upstream data changes or snapshots are refreshed.

## Additional Notes
- Follows Data Vault best practices for t-link modeling.
- Documentation and tests are maintained in accordance with the project style guide.
