      - name: pricing_structure
        description: Pricing model for the opportunity (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price).
        expr: PRICING_STRUCTURE
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - pricing
          - pricing model

      - name: type
        description: Opportunity type (e.g., New Business, Existing Business).
        expr: TYPE
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - opportunity type
          - opp type

      - name: is_closed
        description: >-
          Whether the opportunity is in a closed state (won or lost).
          Stored as string: 'true' or 'false'. Filter with IS_CLOSED = 'true'.
        expr: IS_CLOSED
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - closed

      - name: is_won
        description: >-
          Whether the opportunity was won.
          Stored as string: 'true' or 'false'. Filter with IS_WON = 'true'.
        expr: IS_WON
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - won

      - name: is_deleted
        description: Whether the opportunity has been deleted in Salesforce.
        expr: IS_DELETED
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - deleted

      - name: started_at_risk
        description: Whether the opportunity was flagged as at-risk.
        expr: STARTED_AT_RISK
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - at risk
          - risk flag

      - name: forecast_category
        description: Salesforce forecast category code.
        expr: FORECAST_CATEGORY
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - forecast cat

      - name: forecast_category_name
        description: Human-readable forecast category (e.g., Pipeline, Best Case, Commit, Closed).
        expr: FORECAST_CATEGORY_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - forecast category name
          - pipeline category

      - name: next_step
        description: Free-text next step recorded on the opportunity.
        expr: NEXT_STEP
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - next action

      - name: customer_lead_name
        description: Name of the customer lead / sponsor.
        expr: CUSTOMER_LEAD_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - customer lead
          - sponsor

      - name: primary_partner_name
        description: Primary partner on the opportunity.
        expr: PRIMARY_PARTNER_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - primary partner
          - partner

      - name: secondary_partner_name
        description: Secondary partner on the opportunity.
        expr: SECONDARY_PARTNER_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms:
          - secondary partner

      - name: record_source
        description: Source system (SALESFORCE).
        expr: RECORD_SOURCE
        data_type: TEXT

    time_dimensions:

      - name: start_date
        description: Opportunity projected start date.
        expr: START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        synonyms:
          - opp start date

      - name: end_date
        description: Opportunity projected end date.
        expr: END_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        synonyms:
          - opp end date

      - name: closed_date
        description: Date the opportunity was closed (won or lost).
        expr: CLOSED_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        synonyms:
          - close date
          - win date

      - name: date_opportunity_was_closed
        description: Actual date the opportunity reached a closed state.
        expr: DATE_OPPORTUNITY_WAS_CLOSED
        data_type: DATE

      - name: created_date
        description: Date the opportunity was created in Salesforce.
        expr: CREATED_DATE
        data_type: DATE
        synonyms:
          - opp created date

      - name: load_date_time
        description: Warehouse load timestamp.
        expr: LOAD_DATE_TIME
        data_type: TIMESTAMP

    facts:

      - name: deal_value
        description: Current deal value of the opportunity (SOW value, defaulting to 0 if NULL).
        expr: DEAL_VALUE
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms:
          - sow value
          - opportunity value
          - deal amount

    metrics:

      - name: total_deal_value
        description: Sum of deal values across opportunities.
        expr: SUM(deal_value)
        synonyms:
          - total pipeline value
          - total opportunity value

      - name: average_deal_value
        description: Average deal value across opportunities.
        expr: AVG(deal_value)

      - name: win_rate

        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_won = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_closed = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
        synonyms:

          - conversion rate
          - close rate

  - name: dim_stage

    base_table:

        expr: STAGE_NAME

      - name: stage_description

      - name: is_active

      - name: record_source

        data_type: TEXT

    time_dimensions:

        description: Warehouse load timestamp.
        expr: LOAD_DATE_TIME
        data_type: TIMESTAMP

    facts:

      - name: probability
        description: >-
          Win probability percentage assigned to this stage (e.g., Prospecting = 10%,
          Commit = 90%, Closed Won = 100%). Use for weighted pipeline calculations.
        expr: PROBABILITY
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms:
          - win probability
          - stage probability
          - likelihood

      - name: sort_order

          in pipeline. Use for stage ordering and progression calculations instead of
          hardcoded values.
        expr: SORT_ORDER
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms:
          - stage order
          - sequence
          - stage position

relationships:

    right_table: dim_opportunity

        right_column: dim_opportunity_sid

  - name: fact_to_dim_stage
    left_table: fact_opportunity_field_history
    right_table: dim_stage
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: stage_name
        right_column: stage_name

verified_queries:

  - name: top_5_stage_movement_drivers_last_two_weeks_with_details
    question: What were the top 5 drivers of pipeline movement in the last two weeks, including opportunity name, dates, and details?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH stage_transitions AS (
          SELECT
              f.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              f.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
              LAG(f.STAGE_NAME) OVER (
                  PARTITION BY f.OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY f.CREATED_DATE
              )                                                        AS from_stage,
              f.STAGE_NAME                                              AS to_stage,
              TRY_CAST(f.AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2))                        AS amount,
              f.CREATED_DATE                                            AS transition_date
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history f
          WHERE f.STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      ),
      filtered_transitions AS (
          SELECT
              st.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              st.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
              st.from_stage,
              st.to_stage,
              st.amount,
              st.transition_date
          FROM stage_transitions st
          WHERE st.transition_date >= DATEADD('day', -14, CURRENT_DATE())
            AND st.transition_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
            AND st.from_stage IS NOT NULL
            AND st.from_stage != st.to_stage
      ),
      top_drivers AS (
          SELECT
              ft.from_stage,
              ft.to_stage,
              COUNT(*)                                                  AS transition_count,
              SUM(COALESCE(ft.amount, 0))                               AS total_deal_value,
              DENSE_RANK() OVER (
                  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(COALESCE(ft.amount, 0)) DESC
              )                                                         AS driver_rank
          FROM filtered_transitions ft
          GROUP BY ft.from_stage, ft.to_stage
          QUALIFY driver_rank <= 5
      )
      SELECT
          td.driver_rank,
          td.from_stage,
          td.to_stage,
          td.transition_count,
          td.total_deal_value,
          ft.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
          o.OPPORTUNITY_NAME,
          o.SERVICE_OFFERING,
          o.CUSTOMER_LEAD_NAME,
          ft.transition_date,
          ft.amount
      FROM top_drivers td
      JOIN filtered_transitions ft
        ON td.from_stage = ft.from_stage
       AND td.to_stage = ft.to_stage
      LEFT JOIN __dim_opportunity o
        ON ft.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID = o.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID
      ORDER BY td.driver_rank, ft.transition_date DESC, ft.amount DESC;

  - name: top_5_stage_movement_drivers_this_week
    question: What are the top 5 drivers of pipeline stage movement this week?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH stage_transitions AS (
        SELECT
          OPPORTUNITY_BK,
          LAG(STAGE_NAME) OVER (
            PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE
          ) AS from_stage,
          STAGE_NAME AS to_stage,
          TRY_CAST(AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS amount,
          CREATED_DATE
        FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
        WHERE STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
        from_stage,
        to_stage,
        COUNT(*)                 AS transition_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS total_deal_value
      FROM stage_transitions
      WHERE CREATED_DATE >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE())
        AND CREATED_DATE < DATEADD('day', 7, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE()))
        AND from_stage IS NOT NULL
        AND from_stage != to_stage
      GROUP BY from_stage, to_stage
      ORDER BY transition_count DESC, total_deal_value DESC
      LIMIT 5;

  - name: opportunities_that_moved_stage_this_week
    question: Which opportunities moved stage this week?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH week_bounds AS (
          SELECT
              DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE()) AS week_start,
              CURRENT_DATE()                      AS week_end
      ),
      transitions AS (
          SELECT
              f.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              f.STAGE_NAME                                            AS to_stage,
              LAG(f.STAGE_NAME) OVER (
                  PARTITION BY f.OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY f.CREATED_DATE
              )                                                       AS from_stage,
              TRY_CAST(f.AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2))                     AS amount,
              f.CREATED_DATE
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history f
          WHERE f.STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          t.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
          t.from_stage,
          t.to_stage,
          so_from.SORT_ORDER                                          AS from_seq,
          so_to.SORT_ORDER                                            AS to_seq,
          so_to.SORT_ORDER - so_from.SORT_ORDER                       AS stages_moved,
          CASE
              WHEN so_to.SORT_ORDER > so_from.SORT_ORDER THEN 'Progressed'
              WHEN t.to_stage = 'Closed Lost'            THEN 'Lost'
              ELSE                                             'Regressed'
          END                                                         AS direction,
          t.amount,
          t.CREATED_DATE
      FROM transitions t
      CROSS JOIN week_bounds wb
      LEFT JOIN __dim_stage so_from ON t.from_stage = so_from.STAGE_NAME
      LEFT JOIN __dim_stage so_to   ON t.to_stage   = so_to.STAGE_NAME
      WHERE t.CREATED_DATE >= wb.week_start
        AND t.CREATED_DATE <= wb.week_end
        AND t.from_stage IS NOT NULL
        AND t.from_stage != t.to_stage
      ORDER BY ABS(so_to.SORT_ORDER - so_from.SORT_ORDER) DESC, t.amount DESC;

  - name: average_days_per_stage
    question: How long do opportunities spend in each stage on average?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH stage_changes AS (
          SELECT
              OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              STAGE_NAME,
              CREATED_DATE,
              LEAD(CREATED_DATE) OVER (
                  PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE
              ) AS next_change_date
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
          WHERE STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          sc.STAGE_NAME,
          s.SORT_ORDER,
          COUNT(*)                                                    AS transitions_out,
          AVG(DATEDIFF('day', sc.CREATED_DATE, sc.next_change_date)) AS avg_days_in_stage,
          MEDIAN(DATEDIFF('day', sc.CREATED_DATE, sc.next_change_date)) AS median_days_in_stage,
          MIN(DATEDIFF('day', sc.CREATED_DATE, sc.next_change_date)) AS min_days_in_stage,
          MAX(DATEDIFF('day', sc.CREATED_DATE, sc.next_change_date)) AS max_days_in_stage
      FROM stage_changes sc
      LEFT JOIN __dim_stage s ON sc.STAGE_NAME = s.STAGE_NAME
      WHERE sc.next_change_date IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY sc.STAGE_NAME, s.SORT_ORDER
      ORDER BY s.SORT_ORDER;

  - name: closed_won_velocity
    question: Which opportunities reached Closed Won fastest?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH stage_dates AS (
          SELECT
              OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              MIN(CASE WHEN STAGE_NAME = 'Prospecting'  THEN CREATED_DATE END) AS first_prospecting,
              MIN(CASE WHEN STAGE_NAME = 'Closed Won' THEN CREATED_DATE END) AS closed_won_date
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
          WHERE STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY OPPORTUNITY_BK
      ),
      latest_amount AS (
          SELECT
              OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              TRY_CAST(AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS deal_value,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                  PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
              ) AS rn
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
          WHERE AMOUNT IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          sd.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
          sd.first_prospecting,
          sd.closed_won_date,
          DATEDIFF('day', sd.first_prospecting, sd.closed_won_date)   AS days_to_close,
          la.deal_value
      FROM stage_dates sd
      LEFT JOIN latest_amount la
          ON sd.OPPORTUNITY_BK = la.OPPORTUNITY_BK AND la.rn = 1
      WHERE sd.closed_won_date IS NOT NULL
        AND sd.first_prospecting IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY days_to_close ASC
      LIMIT 10;

  - name: stage_conversion_rates
    question: What is the conversion rate between each stage?
    use_as_onboarding_question: false
    sql: |
      WITH opp_stages AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
              OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              STAGE_NAME
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
          WHERE STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      ),
      stage_counts AS (
          SELECT
              s.STAGE_NAME,
              s.SORT_ORDER,
              COUNT(DISTINCT os.OPPORTUNITY_BK) AS opp_count
          FROM __dim_stage s
          LEFT JOIN opp_stages os ON s.STAGE_NAME = os.STAGE_NAME
          WHERE s.STAGE_NAME != 'Closed Lost'
          GROUP BY s.STAGE_NAME, s.SORT_ORDER
      )
      SELECT
          sc.STAGE_NAME,
          sc.opp_count,
          LAG(sc.opp_count) OVER (ORDER BY sc.SORT_ORDER)            AS prev_stage_count,
          ROUND(
              sc.opp_count * 100.0
              / NULLIF(LAG(sc.opp_count) OVER (ORDER BY sc.SORT_ORDER), 0),
              1
          )                                                            AS conversion_rate_pct
      FROM stage_counts sc
      ORDER BY sc.SORT_ORDER;

  - name: total_pipeline_value_by_stage
    question: What is the total pipeline value by stage?
    use_as_onboarding_question: false
    sql: |
      WITH latest_per_opp AS (
          SELECT
              OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              STAGE_NAME,
              TRY_CAST(AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS amount,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                  PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
              ) AS rn
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history
          WHERE STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          l.STAGE_NAME,
          s.SORT_ORDER,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.OPPORTUNITY_BK) AS opportunity_count,
          SUM(l.amount) AS total_pipeline_value
      FROM latest_per_opp l
      LEFT JOIN __dim_stage s ON l.STAGE_NAME = s.STAGE_NAME
      WHERE l.rn = 1
      GROUP BY l.STAGE_NAME, s.SORT_ORDER
      ORDER BY s.SORT_ORDER;

  - name: pipeline_value_by_service_offering
    question: What is the current pipeline value by service offering?
    use_as_onboarding_question: true
    sql: |
      WITH latest_per_opp AS (
          SELECT
              f.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              f.STAGE_NAME,
              TRY_CAST(f.AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS amount,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                  PARTITION BY f.OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY f.CREATED_DATE DESC
              ) AS rn
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history f
          WHERE f.STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          o.SERVICE_OFFERING,
          l.STAGE_NAME,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.OPPORTUNITY_BK) AS opportunity_count,
          SUM(l.amount)                    AS total_pipeline_value
      FROM latest_per_opp l
      JOIN __dim_opportunity o
          ON l.OPPORTUNITY_BK = o.OPPORTUNITY_BK
      WHERE l.rn = 1
        AND o.IS_CLOSED = 'false'
      GROUP BY o.SERVICE_OFFERING, l.STAGE_NAME
      ORDER BY o.SERVICE_OFFERING, total_pipeline_value DESC;

  - name: weighted_pipeline_by_stage
    question: What is the weighted pipeline value by stage?
    use_as_onboarding_question: false
    sql: |
      WITH latest_per_opp AS (
          SELECT
              f.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              f.STAGE_NAME,
              TRY_CAST(f.AMOUNT AS NUMBER(18,2)) AS amount,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                  PARTITION BY f.OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY f.CREATED_DATE DESC
              ) AS rn
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history f
          WHERE f.STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          s.STAGE_NAME,
          s.SORT_ORDER,
          s.PROBABILITY,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.OPPORTUNITY_BK)                  AS opportunity_count,
          SUM(l.amount)                                     AS total_pipeline_value,
          SUM(l.amount * s.PROBABILITY / 100.0)             AS weighted_pipeline_value
      FROM latest_per_opp l
      JOIN __dim_stage s
          ON l.STAGE_NAME = s.STAGE_NAME
      WHERE l.rn = 1
      GROUP BY s.STAGE_NAME, s.SORT_ORDER, s.PROBABILITY
      ORDER BY s.SORT_ORDER;

  - name: fastest_progressions_by_service_offering
    question: Which service offerings progress through stages fastest?
    use_as_onboarding_question: false
    sql: |
      WITH stage_changes AS (
          SELECT
              f.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              f.STAGE_NAME,
              f.CREATED_DATE,
              LEAD(f.CREATED_DATE) OVER (
                  PARTITION BY f.OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY f.CREATED_DATE
              ) AS next_change_date
          FROM __fact_opportunity_field_history f
          WHERE f.STAGE_NAME IS NOT NULL
      ),
      with_offering AS (
          SELECT
              sc.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
              sc.STAGE_NAME,
              o.SERVICE_OFFERING,
              DATEDIFF('day', sc.CREATED_DATE, sc.next_change_date) AS days_in_stage,
              s.SORT_ORDER
          FROM stage_changes sc
          JOIN __dim_opportunity o
              ON sc.OPPORTUNITY_BK = o.OPPORTUNITY_BK
          JOIN __dim_stage s
              ON sc.STAGE_NAME = s.STAGE_NAME
          WHERE sc.next_change_date IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT
          SERVICE_OFFERING,
          STAGE_NAME,
          SORT_ORDER,
          COUNT(*)                AS transitions,
          AVG(days_in_stage)      AS avg_days_in_stage,
          MEDIAN(days_in_stage)   AS median_days_in_stage
      FROM with_offering
      GROUP BY SERVICE_OFFERING, STAGE_NAME, SORT_ORDER
      ORDER BY SERVICE_OFFERING, SORT_ORDER;
{% endset %}
{{ return(yaml_content) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.cr_project.sv_yaml_revenue_pipelin.name: sv_yaml_revenue_pipeline
macro.cr_project.sv_yaml_revenue_pipelin.macro_sql:
{% macro sv_yaml_revenue_pipeline() %}
{% set yaml_content %}
name: revenue_pipeline
description: >
  Consolidated revenue and pipeline analysis. Combines actual revenue, journal-line revenue,
  and the R1-R5 sales-pipeline waterfall (Closed Won -> Commit -> Best Case -> Validating ->
  Qualifying -> Prospecting). Sourced from FACT_ACTUAL_REVENUE, FACT_JOURNAL_LINES, and
  REPORTING.REP_REVENUE_R1_R4. The R1-R5 metrics use static stage-based aggregation  -- 
  see module_custom_instructions for caveats vs the Power BI report.

module_custom_instructions:
  sql_generation: |
    - Three fact tables in this view, each with a different grain:
        fact_actual_revenue        --  one row per (date, project, revenue category) actual revenue
        fact_journal_lines         --  one row per ledger entry (granular debit/credit)
        fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4     --  one row per (date x stage x project x source_row), where
                                    TABLE_SOURCE indicates origin: 'fact_forecast_booking',
                                    'fact_sow_amount', or actuals
      Use the right fact for the question  --  do NOT join across them unnecessarily.
    - "R1" through "R5" refer to a stacked pipeline waterfall (R5 >= R4 >= R3 >= R2 >= R1):
        R1 = Closed Won + Commit
        R2 = R1 + Best Case
        R3 = R2 + Validating
        R4 = R3 + Qualifying
        R5 = R4 + Prospecting
      Each layer is a stacked sum of the prior  --  these are exposed as r1_revenue ... r5_revenue
      metrics. They use a static CASE on dim_stage.stage_name; the Power BI version uses a
      dynamic workday-cutoff to switch some stages between actuals and forecast that is NOT
      reproduced here. Consumers needing PBI-exact numbers must wait for the deployment of
      V_REVENUE_PIPELINE_R1_R5.
    - "Actual revenue" can come from two places:
        fact_actual_revenue.revenue_amount   --  clean DATA_MART-grain revenue, preferred.
        fact_journal_lines.revenue_amount    --  ledger-level revenue, granular.
      Prefer fact_actual_revenue for KPI-style questions. Use fact_journal_lines for
      drill-down/audit-style questions (which JE/account/cost-centre).
    - dim_opportunity.is_closed is VARIANT  --  use TRY_CAST(IS_CLOSED::STRING AS BOOLEAN).
      dim_opportunity.is_won is BOOLEAN.
    - dim_cost_center.cost_center_category is a derived classification (Modern Build,
      Advisory, Telstra Purple, Licence Revenue, Other) replacing V_DIM_COST_CENTER_ENRICHED.
    - Format dollar amounts as TO_VARCHAR(value, '$999,999,999,999.00').
    - When the user asks about "weighted pipeline", use weighted_revenue (probability-adjusted)
      not the raw amount.
    - "Excludes ICO Cost Recovery & Telstra Internal" matches the PBI report's standard
      filter  --  apply a WHERE on dim_cost_center.cost_center_name NOT ILIKE '%ICO Cost Recovery%'
      AND NOT ILIKE '%Telstra Internal%' if the user replicates a "Consolidated Revenue" page query.

        expr: |
          CASE

    primary_key:

    dimensions:

        data_type: TEXT

  - name: fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4
    description: >
      Pipeline revenue at (date x stage x project x source) grain. TABLE_SOURCE indicates
      whether the row originated from fact_forecast_booking, fact_sow_amount, or actuals.
      This is the substrate for the R1-R5 stacked metrics.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: REPORTING
      table: REP_REVENUE_R1_R4
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_DATE_SID
        - DIM_STAGE_SID
        - DIM_PROJECT_SID
        - TABLE_SOURCE

    dimensions:
      - name: cr_type
        description: Cost-recovery type classifier on the row.
        expr: CR_TYPE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: table_source
        description: Origin of the row (fact_forecast_booking / fact_sow_amount / actuals).
        expr: TABLE_SOURCE
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [source]
    time_dimensions:
      - name: effective_from
        expr: EFFECTIVE_FROM
        data_type: DATE
      - name: effective_to
        expr: EFFECTIVE_TO
        data_type: DATE

    facts:
      - name: amount
        description: Pipeline revenue amount (raw).
        expr: AMOUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: weighted_amount
        description: Stage-probability-weighted amount.
        expr: WEIGHTED_AMOUNT
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: hours
        expr: HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: fte
        expr: FTE
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: weighted_fte
        expr: WEIGHTED_FTE
        data_type: NUMBER

    metrics:
      - name: total_pipeline_amount
        description: Sum of pipeline amount across all stages.
        expr: SUM(fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount)
      - name: total_weighted_pipeline_amount
        description: Sum of probability-weighted pipeline amount.
        expr: SUM(fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.weighted_amount)
        synonyms: [weighted pipeline]
      - name: total_pipeline_hours
        expr: SUM(fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.hours)
      - name: total_pipeline_fte
        expr: SUM(fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.fte)
      - name: total_pipeline_weighted_fte
        expr: SUM(fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.weighted_fte)
      # Source-classified revenue (replaces V_REP_REVENUE_R1_R4_ENRICHED.SOLD_OR_FORECAST)
      - name: forecast_pipeline_amount
        description: Pipeline amount sourced from forecast booking.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.table_source = 'fact_forecast_booking' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: sow_pipeline_amount
        description: Pipeline amount sourced from SOW.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.table_source = 'fact_sow_amount' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: actuals_pipeline_amount
        description: Pipeline amount sourced from actuals (anything other than forecast/SOW).
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.table_source NOT IN ('fact_forecast_booking','fact_sow_amount') THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      # Stage-classified pipeline amounts (joins through fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4 -> dim_stage)
      - name: closed_won_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where dim_stage.stage_name = 'Closed Won'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Closed Won' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: commit_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where stage = 'Commit'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Commit' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: best_case_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where stage = 'Best Case'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Best Case' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: validating_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where stage = 'Validating'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Validating' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: qualifying_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where stage = 'Qualifying'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Qualifying' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: prospecting_revenue
        description: Pipeline amount where stage = 'Prospecting'.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name = 'Prospecting' THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      # R1-R5 stacked layers
      - name: r1_revenue
        description: R1 = Closed Won + Commit. Most-likely revenue.
        expr: |
          SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name IN ('Closed Won', 'Commit')
                   THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: r2_revenue
        description: R2 = R1 + Best Case.
        expr: |
          SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name IN ('Closed Won', 'Commit', 'Best Case')
                   THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: r3_revenue
        description: R3 = R2 + Validating.
        expr: |
          SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name IN ('Closed Won', 'Commit', 'Best Case', 'Validating')
                   THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: r4_revenue
        description: R4 = R3 + Qualifying.
        expr: |
          SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name IN ('Closed Won', 'Commit', 'Best Case', 'Validating', 'Qualifying')
                   THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - name: r5_revenue
        description: R5 = R4 + Prospecting (full pipeline).
        expr: |
          SUM(CASE WHEN dim_stage.stage_name IN ('Closed Won', 'Commit', 'Best Case', 'Validating', 'Qualifying', 'Prospecting')
                   THEN fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4.amount ELSE 0 END)

verified_queries:

  - name: total_actual_revenue_by_month_fy26
    question: What was Versent's actual revenue per month in FY26?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        d.MONTH_NAME_SHORT_YEAR  AS month,
        SUM(r.REVENUE_AMOUNT)    AS actual_revenue
      FROM __fact_actual_revenue r
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON r.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY d.MONTH_NAME_SHORT_YEAR, d.MONTH_START_DATE
      ORDER BY d.MONTH_START_DATE;

  - name: r1_to_r5_pipeline_fy26
    question: What is the FY26 R1-R5 pipeline waterfall?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.STAGE_NAME IN ('Closed Won','Commit') THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS r1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.STAGE_NAME IN ('Closed Won','Commit','Best Case') THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS r2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.STAGE_NAME IN ('Closed Won','Commit','Best Case','Validating') THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS r3,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.STAGE_NAME IN ('Closed Won','Commit','Best Case','Validating','Qualifying') THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS r4,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.STAGE_NAME IN ('Closed Won','Commit','Best Case','Validating','Qualifying','Prospecting') THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS r5
      FROM __fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4 p
      JOIN __dim_stage s
        ON p.DIM_STAGE_SID = s.DIM_STAGE_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON p.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026';

  - name: weighted_pipeline_by_service_offering
    question: What is the FY26 weighted pipeline amount by service offering?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        pr.SERVICE_OFFERING        AS service_offering,
        SUM(p.WEIGHTED_AMOUNT)     AS weighted_pipeline
      FROM __fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4 p
      JOIN __dim_project pr
        ON p.DIM_PROJECT_SID = pr.DIM_PROJECT_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON p.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY pr.SERVICE_OFFERING
      ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC NULLS LAST;

  - name: forecast_vs_actuals_split_fy26
    question: For FY26 pipeline, how much comes from forecast vs SOW vs actuals?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        p.TABLE_SOURCE  AS source,
        SUM(p.AMOUNT)   AS amount
      FROM __fact_rep_revenue_r1_r4 p
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON p.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY p.TABLE_SOURCE
      ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST;

  - name: top_10_opportunities_by_deal_value
    question: What are the top 10 open opportunities by deal value?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        o.OPPORTUNITY_NAME  AS opportunity,
        o.SERVICE_OFFERING  AS service_offering,
        o.DEAL_VALUE        AS deal_value
      FROM __dim_opportunity o
      WHERE COALESCE(TRY_CAST(o.IS_CLOSED::STRING AS BOOLEAN), FALSE) = FALSE
      ORDER BY o.DEAL_VALUE DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 10;
{% endset %}

{% macro sv_yaml_timesheets() %}
{% set yaml_content %}
name: timesheets
description: >
  Time tracking and billable-hours analysis for Versent's professional services workforce.
  One row per timesheet line item with hours, rates, billing status and project context.
  Use this view for billable-hours questions, cost-vs-revenue per project/practice,
  and internal-vs-external time splits. For utilisation (supply / demand), see the
  utilisation semantic view (when available).

module_custom_instructions:
  sql_generation: |
    - Only use the logical tables and columns defined in this semantic model.
    - Hourly rate convention: Versent's standard workday is 7.6 hours. The PBI model uses
      HOURLY_RATE_CALC = BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6 and AMOUNT_CALC = HOURLY_RATE_CALC * BILLABLE_HOURS.
      These are exposed as facts hourly_rate_calc and amount_calc on fact_time_sheet.
    - "Billable" rows have BILLABLE_HOURS > 0. The is_billable flag exposed on fact_time_sheet
      computes this. Non-billable hours = TOTAL_HOURS - BILLABLE_HOURS.
    - "Internal" vs "External" is derived from dim_cost_center.business_unit. Internal cost
      centres include 'ICO Cost Recovery', 'Telstra Internal' and admin/transformation/innovation
      project groups. The internal_external dimension on dim_cost_center implements the same
      classification used in the PBI model.
    - PAST_FUTURE in PBI is a runtime cutoff: rows with date < end-of-prior-week are "Past"
      (actuals), date >= end-of-prior-week are "Future". The semantic view does not bake this
      in because it depends on CURRENT_DATE(). Use a date filter on dim_date.date if you need
      this split.
    - "Working days in month" is a runtime calculation; not provided as a metric. If asked,
      compute as DATEDIFF day where dim_date.is_weekday = TRUE.
    - Format dollar amounts with TO_VARCHAR(value, '$999,999,999.00') and hour totals to
      one decimal place with TO_VARCHAR(value, 'FM999,999,990.0').
    - When the user asks about "utilisation %", clarify whether they want billable %
      (this view: SUM(billable_hours) / NULLIF(SUM(total_hours), 0)) or true utilisation
      (supply-vs-demand  --  separate view, not yet available).

    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_PROJECT_ROLE_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_project_role_sid
        expr: DIM_PROJECT_ROLE_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: project_role
        description: Project role name.
        expr: PROJECT_ROLE
        data_type: TEXT

  - name: dim_client
    description: Client/customer master.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_CLIENT
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_CLIENT_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_client_sid
        expr: DIM_CLIENT_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: client_name
        expr: CLIENT_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: industry
        expr: INDUSTRY
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: sector
        expr: SECTOR
        data_type: TEXT

  - name: dim_cost_center
    description: >
      Cost-centre dimension. business_unit is the high-level segmentation used by the PBI
      report ("Professional Services", "Licences", "Telstra Purple", "Purple C&D", etc.).
      The internal_external derived dimension classifies cost centres for billable/non-billable
      analysis.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_COST_CENTER
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_COST_CENTER_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_cost_center_sid
        expr: DIM_COST_CENTER_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: cost_center_name
        expr: COST_CENTER_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [cost centre]
      - name: business_unit
        expr: BUSINESS_UNIT
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [BU]
      - name: internal_external
        description: >
          Derived classification  --  "Internal" for ICO Cost Recovery / Telstra Internal /
          admin / transformation / innovation cost centres; "External" otherwise.
          Replaces V_FACT_TIME_SHEET_ENRICHED.INTERNAL_EXTERNAL classification at the
          cost-centre level.
        expr: |
          CASE
            WHEN UPPER(COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%ICO COST RECOVERY%'
              OR UPPER(COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%TELSTRA INTERNAL%'
              OR UPPER(COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%ADMIN%'
              OR UPPER(COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%TRANSFORMATION%'
              OR UPPER(COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%INNOVATION%'
            THEN 'Internal'
            ELSE 'External'
          END
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [internal vs external]

  - name: dim_practice
    description: Versent practice (Cloud, Data, Security, DevOps, ...).
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_PRACTICE
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_PRACTICE_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_practice_sid
        expr: DIM_PRACTICE_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: practice_name
        expr: PRACTICE_NAME
        data_type: TEXT

  - name: fact_time_sheet
    description: >
      Timesheet line items. One row per (timesheet, employee, project, project role, date).
      Carries hours and rates; derived facts compute hourly rate and amount per Versent's
      standard 7.6-hour workday convention.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: FACT_TIME_SHEET
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - TIMESHEET_BK
    filters:
      - name: not_deleted
        description: Drop rows soft-deleted upstream.
        expr: COALESCE(IS_DELETED, FALSE) = FALSE

    dimensions:
      - name: billing_status
        expr: BILLING_STATUS
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: revenue_status
        expr: REVENUE_STATUS
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: billing_currency
        expr: BILLING_CURRENCY
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: cost_rate_currency
        expr: COST_RATE_CURRENCY
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: invoice_number
        expr: INVOICE_NUMBER
        data_type: TEXT
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: task_code
        expr: TASK_CODE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: is_billable
        description: TRUE when this timesheet line has billable hours.
        expr: COALESCE(BILLABLE_HOURS, 0) > 0
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        synonyms: [billable, chargeable]

    facts:
      - name: total_hours
        description: All hours logged on this timesheet line.
        expr: TOTAL_HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: billable_hours
        description: Subset of total_hours that is billable.
        expr: BILLABLE_HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms: [chargeable hours]
      - name: non_billable_hours
        description: Total hours minus billable hours.
        expr: COALESCE(TOTAL_HOURS, 0) - COALESCE(BILLABLE_HOURS, 0)
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: billable_rate
        description: Daily billable rate (raw  --  divide by 7.6 for hourly).
        expr: BILLABLE_RATE
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: cost_rate
        description: Daily cost rate.
        expr: COST_RATE
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: standard_cost_rate
        description: Standard daily cost rate.
        expr: STANDARD_COST_RATE
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: hourly_rate_calc
        description: Hourly rate = BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6 (Versent standard workday).
        expr: BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: amount_calc
        description: Calculated billable amount = hourly_rate * billable_hours.
        expr: (BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6) * BILLABLE_HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms: [billable amount, calculated amount]
      - name: cost_amount
        description: Calculated cost amount = (cost_rate / 7.6) * billable_hours.
        expr: (COST_RATE / 7.6) * BILLABLE_HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER

    metrics:
      - name: total_hours_logged
        description: Sum of all timesheet hours (billable + non-billable).
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.total_hours)
        synonyms: [total time logged]
      - name: total_billable_hours
        description: Sum of billable hours.
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.billable_hours)
      - name: total_non_billable_hours
        description: Sum of non-billable hours.
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.total_hours) - SUM(fact_time_sheet.billable_hours)
      - name: billable_pct_of_total
        description: Billable hours as % of total hours logged.
        expr: |
          DIV0(SUM(fact_time_sheet.billable_hours) * 100,
               SUM(fact_time_sheet.total_hours))
        synonyms: [billable percentage]
      - name: total_billable_amount
        description: Sum of calculated billable amount (hourly rate x billable hours).
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.amount_calc)
        synonyms: [billable revenue, timesheet revenue]
      - name: total_cost_amount
        description: Sum of calculated cost amount (cost rate x billable hours).
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.cost_amount)
      - name: gross_margin_amount
        description: Calculated billable amount minus calculated cost amount.
        expr: SUM(fact_time_sheet.amount_calc) - SUM(fact_time_sheet.cost_amount)
        synonyms: [margin]
      - name: avg_hourly_rate
        description: Average hourly billable rate (BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6).
        expr: AVG(fact_time_sheet.hourly_rate_calc)

relationships:

  - name: timesheet_to_date
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_date
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_DATE_SID
        right_column: DIM_DATE_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_employee
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_employee
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        right_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_project
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_project
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_PROJECT_SID
        right_column: DIM_PROJECT_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_project_role
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_project_role
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_PROJECT_ROLE_SID
        right_column: DIM_PROJECT_ROLE_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_client
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_client
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_CLIENT_SID
        right_column: DIM_CLIENT_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_cost_center
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_cost_center
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_COST_CENTER_SID
        right_column: DIM_COST_CENTER_SID

  - name: timesheet_to_practice
    left_table: fact_time_sheet
    right_table: dim_practice
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_PRACTICE_SID
        right_column: DIM_PRACTICE_SID

verified_queries:

  - name: total_billable_hours_by_month_fy26
    question: How many billable hours did we log per month in FY26?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        d.MONTH_NAME_SHORT_YEAR  AS month,
        SUM(t.BILLABLE_HOURS)    AS billable_hours
      FROM __fact_time_sheet t
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON t.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY d.MONTH_NAME_SHORT_YEAR, d.MONTH_START_DATE
      ORDER BY d.MONTH_START_DATE;

  - name: billable_pct_by_employee_this_quarter
    question: What is each employee's billable percentage this fiscal quarter?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS employee,
        DIV0(SUM(t.BILLABLE_HOURS) * 100, SUM(t.TOTAL_HOURS)) AS billable_pct
      FROM __fact_time_sheet t
      JOIN __dim_employee e
        ON t.DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID = e.DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON t.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
        AND d.QUARTER_START_DATE = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE())
      GROUP BY e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME
      ORDER BY billable_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

  - name: top_10_projects_by_billable_amount
    question: What are the top 10 projects by billable amount this fiscal year?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        p.PROJECT_NAME                              AS project,
        SUM((t.BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6) * t.BILLABLE_HOURS) AS billable_amount
      FROM __fact_time_sheet t
      JOIN __dim_project p
        ON t.DIM_PROJECT_SID = p.DIM_PROJECT_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON t.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY p.PROJECT_NAME
      ORDER BY billable_amount DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT 10;

  - name: internal_vs_external_hours_by_practice
    question: How are internal vs external hours split across practices this quarter?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        p.PRACTICE_NAME                                                AS practice,
        CASE
          WHEN UPPER(c.COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%ICO COST RECOVERY%'
            OR UPPER(c.COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%TELSTRA INTERNAL%'
            OR UPPER(c.COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%ADMIN%'
            OR UPPER(c.COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%TRANSFORMATION%'
            OR UPPER(c.COST_CENTER_NAME) LIKE '%INNOVATION%'
          THEN 'Internal'
          ELSE 'External'
        END                                                            AS classification,
        SUM(t.BILLABLE_HOURS)                                          AS billable_hours
      FROM __fact_time_sheet t
      JOIN __dim_practice p
        ON t.DIM_PRACTICE_SID = p.DIM_PRACTICE_SID
      JOIN __dim_cost_center c
        ON t.DIM_COST_CENTER_SID = c.DIM_COST_CENTER_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON t.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.QUARTER_START_DATE = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE())
      GROUP BY p.PRACTICE_NAME, classification
      ORDER BY p.PRACTICE_NAME, classification;

  - name: cost_vs_revenue_per_practice_fy26
    question: What is the cost vs revenue and gross margin per practice for FY26?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        pr.PRACTICE_NAME                                              AS practice,
        SUM((t.BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6) * t.BILLABLE_HOURS)               AS billable_revenue,
        SUM((t.COST_RATE / 7.6) * t.BILLABLE_HOURS)                   AS cost_amount,
        SUM((t.BILLABLE_RATE / 7.6) * t.BILLABLE_HOURS)
          - SUM((t.COST_RATE / 7.6) * t.BILLABLE_HOURS)               AS gross_margin
      FROM __fact_time_sheet t
      JOIN __dim_practice pr
        ON t.DIM_PRACTICE_SID = pr.DIM_PRACTICE_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON t.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY pr.PRACTICE_NAME
      ORDER BY gross_margin DESC NULLS LAST;
{% endset %}
{{ return(yaml_content) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.cr_project.sv_yaml_workforce_absen.name: sv_yaml_workforce_absence
macro.cr_project.sv_yaml_workforce_absen.macro_sql:
{% macro sv_yaml_workforce_absence() %}
{% set yaml_content %}
name: workforce_absence
description: >
  Employee absence and public-holiday tracking for Versent's professional-services workforce.
  Covers leave hours by absence type, public-holiday impact by employee/region, and the
  supply-hours deductibility classification used by utilisation reporting.
  Domain boundary: workforce attendance/absence only. Timesheets, forecasting, revenue, and
  utilisation supply-hours calculations live in their own semantic views.

module_custom_instructions:
  sql_generation: |
    - Only use the logical tables and columns defined in this semantic model.
    - The fact_employee_absence logical table is filtered to STATUS IN ('Approved','Successfully Completed').
      No additional STATUS filter is needed; do not reapply it. To inspect raw status values, query the
      base table directly (outside the semantic view).
    - The dim_absence_type.is_deductible_from_supply_hours BOOLEAN column drives whether an absence
      reduces an employee's supply hours for utilisation calculations. Most casual/unpaid leave is
      non-deductible; annual leave, personal/carer's leave and similar are deductible.
    - dim_absence_type.is_holiday is a derived flag (TRUE when ABSENCE_TYPE_GROUP ILIKE '%Holiday%')
      that distinguishes public-holiday-related absence categories from leave proper.
    - For "leave hours" prefer fact_employee_absence.working_hours over unit_quantity. unit_quantity
      can be expressed in days or hours depending on the source system; working_hours is normalised.
    - For "public holidays" use fact_employee_public_holiday  --  it is a bridge fact (one row per
      employee x calendar date x holiday observation). It carries no measure of its own; count rows
      to get holiday observations.
    - When the user asks about "this fiscal year" or "FY26", filter on dim_date.fy_number_string
      (TEXT)  --  not fy_number  --  to match values like 'FY2026'.
    - dim_employee.hire_date and termination_date are TEXT columns. Use TRY_TO_DATE() before any
      date arithmetic. dim_employee.recent_termination_date is already DATE-typed and is preferred.
    - Format hour totals to 1 decimal place: TO_VARCHAR(value, 'FM999,999,990.0').

tables:

  - name: dim_date
    description: >
      Calendar and fiscal-year date dimension. Use the *_start_date / *_end_date columns
      for window aggregation (week, month, quarter, year, fiscal year).
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_DATE
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_DATE_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_date_sid
        description: Surrogate key for the date dimension.
        expr: DIM_DATE_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: day_of_week_name
        description: Day of week name (Monday, Tuesday, ...).
        expr: DAY_OF_WEEK_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [weekday]
      - name: is_weekday
        description: TRUE for Monday-Friday, FALSE for Saturday/Sunday.
        expr: IS_WEEKDAY
        data_type: BOOLEAN
      - name: month_name
        description: Full English month name (January, February, ...).
        expr: MONTH_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: month_name_short_year
        description: Short month + year, e.g. "Jan 2026".
        expr: MONTH_NAME_SHORT_YEAR
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: quarter_of_year
        description: Calendar quarter (1-4).
        expr: QUARTER_OF_YEAR
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: year_number
        description: Calendar year (e.g. 2026).
        expr: YEAR_NUMBER
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms: [calendar year]
      - name: fy_number
        description: Fiscal-year number as integer (e.g. 2026 for Versent FY26).
        expr: FY_NUMBER
        data_type: NUMBER
        synonyms: [fiscal year]
      - name: fy_number_string
        description: Fiscal-year number as label, e.g. "FY2026".
        expr: FY_NUMBER_STRING
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: fy_quarter_number_string
        description: Fiscal-year quarter label, e.g. "Q1".
        expr: FY_QUARTER_NUMBER_STRING
        data_type: TEXT

    time_dimensions:
      - name: date
        description: Calendar date for this row.
        expr: DATE
        data_type: DATE
        synonyms: [day]
      - name: week_start_date
        description: Sunday-anchored week start.
        expr: WEEK_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
      - name: iso_week_start_date
        description: ISO week start (Monday).
        expr: ISO_WEEK_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
      - name: month_start_date
        description: First day of the calendar month.
        expr: MONTH_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
      - name: quarter_start_date
        description: First day of the calendar quarter.
        expr: QUARTER_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE
      - name: year_start_date
        description: First day of the calendar year.
        expr: YEAR_START_DATE
        data_type: DATE

  - name: dim_employee
    description: >
      Employee master. Includes worker type (Permanent/Contractor/Casual), function,
      practice, region, FTE, hire/termination dates and cost-centre history.
      WORK_EMAIL, FIRST_NAME and LAST_NAME are PII  --  recommend tag-based DDM at the
      base-table level.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_EMPLOYEE
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_employee_sid
        description: Surrogate key for the employee dimension.
        expr: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: employee_bk
        description: Business key for the employee (Workday WID).
        expr: EMPLOYEE_BK
        data_type: TEXT
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: full_name
        description: Concatenated first + last name. Replaces V_DIM_EMPLOYEE_ENRICHED.FULL_NAME.
        expr: FIRST_NAME || ' ' || LAST_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [employee name]
      - name: first_name
        description: Employee first name.
        expr: FIRST_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: last_name
        description: Employee last name.
        expr: LAST_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: work_email
        description: Employee Versent email address.
        expr: WORK_EMAIL
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [email]
      - name: worker_type
        description: Permanent / Contractor / Casual / Intern.
        expr: WORKER_TYPE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: worker_subtype
        description: More-specific worker classification (e.g. "Fixed Term", "Independent Contractor").
        expr: WORKER_SUBTYPE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: function
        description: Employee function (Pre-Sales, Services - Delivery, Corporate, etc.).
        expr: FUNCTION
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: practice
        description: Versent practice (Cloud, Data, Security, DevOps, ...).
        expr: PRACTICE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: location
        description: Workplace location.
        expr: LOCATION
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: business_title
        description: Job title (e.g. "Senior Consultant").
        expr: BUSINESS_TITLE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: manager
        description: Direct manager's name.
        expr: MANAGER
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: fte
        description: Full-time-equivalent fraction (1.0 = full-time).
        expr: FTE
        data_type: NUMBER

    time_dimensions:
      - name: hire_date
        description: Employee hire date. Stored as TEXT  --  use TRY_TO_DATE for date arithmetic.
        expr: TRY_TO_DATE(HIRE_DATE)
        data_type: DATE
      - name: recent_termination_date
        description: Employee's most recent termination date (DATE-typed).
        expr: RECENT_TERMINATION_DATE
        data_type: DATE
      - name: cost_centre_change_date
        description: Date the employee's cost centre last changed.
        expr: COST_CENTRE_CHANGE_DATE
        data_type: DATE

  - name: dim_absence_type
    description: >
      Catalogue of absence types (Annual Leave, Personal/Carer's Leave, Compassionate Leave,
      Public Holiday, etc.) with deductibility classification used by utilisation reporting.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_absence_type_sid
        description: Surrogate key for the absence-type dimension.
        expr: DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: absence_name
        description: Full absence-type display name (e.g. "Annual Leave").
        expr: ABSENCE_NAME
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [leave type, time off]
      - name: absence_type
        description: Short absence-type code.
        expr: ABSENCE_TYPE
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: absence_type_group
        description: Higher-level grouping (e.g. "Paid Leave", "Public Holiday", "Unpaid").
        expr: ABSENCE_TYPE_GROUP
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: is_deductible_from_supply_hours
        description: TRUE when this absence type reduces an employee's supply hours for utilisation purposes.
        expr: IS_DEDUCTIBLE_FROM_SUPPLY_HOURS
        data_type: BOOLEAN
      - name: is_holiday
        description: >
          Derived flag  --  TRUE when ABSENCE_TYPE_GROUP indicates this is a public-holiday absence
          rather than ordinary leave. Replaces V_DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_ENRICHED.IS_HOLIDAY_FLAG.
        expr: COALESCE(ABSENCE_TYPE_GROUP ILIKE '%Holiday%', FALSE)
        data_type: BOOLEAN

  - name: dim_public_holiday
    description: >
      Public-holiday calendar. One row per (date, location) holiday observation.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_SID

    dimensions:
      - name: dim_public_holiday_sid
        description: Surrogate key.
        expr: DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_SID
        data_type: BINARY
        access_modifier: private_access
      - name: holiday
        description: Holiday name (e.g. "Australia Day", "New Year's Day").
        expr: HOLIDAY
        data_type: TEXT
        synonyms: [holiday name, public holiday]
      - name: location
        description: Location/jurisdiction the holiday applies to.
        expr: LOCATION
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: status
        description: Holiday observation status.
        expr: STATUS
        data_type: TEXT

    time_dimensions:
      - name: holiday_date
        description: Calendar date of the public holiday.
        expr: DATE
        data_type: DATE

  - name: fact_employee_absence
    description: >
      Approved/completed employee absence events  --  one row per (employee, date, absence type)
      occurrence. Filtered to STATUS IN ('Approved','Successfully Completed') to replace the
      missing V_FACT_EMPLOYEE_ABSENCE_FILTERED view.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: FACT_EMPLOYEE_ABSENCE
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        - DIM_DATE_SID
        - DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
    filters:
      - name: only_approved_or_completed
        description: Drop pending/cancelled/rejected absence rows.
        expr: STATUS IN ('Approved', 'Successfully Completed')

    dimensions:
      - name: status
        description: Absence approval status (always Approved/Successfully Completed in this view).
        expr: STATUS
        data_type: TEXT
      - name: unit_of_time
        description: Unit of measure for unit_quantity (Hours / Days).
        expr: UNIT_OF_TIME
        data_type: TEXT

    facts:
      - name: unit_quantity
        description: Raw absence quantity in unit_of_time. Prefer working_hours for cross-employee aggregation.
        expr: UNIT_QUANTITY
        data_type: NUMBER
      - name: working_hours
        description: Normalised absence duration in hours.
        expr: WORKING_HOURS
        data_type: NUMBER

    metrics:
      - name: total_leave_hours
        description: Sum of working_hours across all approved absences.
        expr: SUM(fact_employee_absence.working_hours)
        synonyms: [leave hours, time off hours]
      - name: total_leave_units
        description: Sum of unit_quantity (unit_of_time-dependent  --  beware mixing days and hours).
        expr: SUM(fact_employee_absence.unit_quantity)
      - name: absence_event_count
        description: Number of distinct (employee, date, absence-type) absence rows.
        expr: COUNT(*)
        synonyms: [number of absences]
      - name: deductible_leave_hours
        description: Leave hours that count against utilisation supply hours.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_absence_type.is_deductible_from_supply_hours THEN fact_employee_absence.working_hours ELSE 0 END)
      - name: non_deductible_leave_hours
        description: Leave hours that do not reduce supply hours.
        expr: SUM(CASE WHEN NOT dim_absence_type.is_deductible_from_supply_hours THEN fact_employee_absence.working_hours ELSE 0 END)

  - name: fact_employee_public_holiday
    description: >
      Bridge fact linking employees to public-holiday observations they were eligible for.
      One row per (employee, date, location, holiday). No measures  --  count rows.
    base_table:
      database: __TARGET_DATABASE__
      schema: DATA_MART
      table: FACT_EMPLOYEE_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY
    primary_key:
      columns:
        - DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        - DIM_DATE_SID
        - DIM_LOCATION_SID
        - DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_SID

    metrics:
      - name: public_holiday_observation_count
        description: Number of (employee, date, holiday) public-holiday observations.
        expr: COUNT(*)
        synonyms: [public holidays observed, holiday count]

relationships:

  - name: absence_to_date
    left_table: fact_employee_absence
    right_table: dim_date
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_DATE_SID
        right_column: DIM_DATE_SID

  - name: absence_to_employee
    left_table: fact_employee_absence
    right_table: dim_employee
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        right_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID

  - name: absence_to_absence_type
    left_table: fact_employee_absence
    right_table: dim_absence_type
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
        right_column: DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID

  - name: public_holiday_to_date
    left_table: fact_employee_public_holiday
    right_table: dim_date
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_DATE_SID
        right_column: DIM_DATE_SID

  - name: public_holiday_to_employee
    left_table: fact_employee_public_holiday
    right_table: dim_employee
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID
        right_column: DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID

  - name: public_holiday_to_holiday
    left_table: fact_employee_public_holiday
    right_table: dim_public_holiday
    relationship_columns:
      - left_column: DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_SID
        right_column: DIM_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_SID

verified_queries:

  - name: total_leave_hours_by_quarter_fy26
    question: How many leave hours did Versent employees take in each quarter of FY26?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        d.fy_quarter_number_string AS quarter,
        SUM(a.working_hours)       AS leave_hours
      FROM __fact_employee_absence a
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON a.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY d.fy_quarter_number_string
      ORDER BY d.fy_quarter_number_string;

  - name: leave_hours_by_absence_type
    question: What is the breakdown of leave hours by absence type this calendar year?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        t.ABSENCE_NAME       AS absence_type,
        SUM(a.WORKING_HOURS) AS leave_hours
      FROM __fact_employee_absence a
      JOIN __dim_absence_type t
        ON a.DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID = t.DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON a.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.YEAR_NUMBER = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
      GROUP BY t.ABSENCE_NAME
      ORDER BY leave_hours DESC;

  - name: deductible_vs_non_deductible_leave
    question: How much of our leave is deductible from supply hours vs not?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        d.FY_NUMBER_STRING                                            AS fiscal_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_DEDUCTIBLE_FROM_SUPPLY_HOURS THEN a.WORKING_HOURS ELSE 0 END) AS deductible_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.IS_DEDUCTIBLE_FROM_SUPPLY_HOURS THEN a.WORKING_HOURS ELSE 0 END) AS non_deductible_hours
      FROM __fact_employee_absence a
      JOIN __dim_absence_type t
        ON a.DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID = t.DIM_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON a.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      GROUP BY d.FY_NUMBER_STRING
      ORDER BY d.FY_NUMBER_STRING;

  - name: public_holiday_observations_by_quarter
    question: How many public-holiday observations did our workforce log per quarter this fiscal year?
    sql: |
      SELECT
        d.FY_QUARTER_NUMBER_STRING AS quarter,
        COUNT(*)                   AS observations
      FROM __fact_employee_public_holiday h
      JOIN __dim_date d
        ON h.DIM_DATE_SID = d.DIM_DATE_SID
      WHERE d.FY_NUMBER_STRING = 'FY2026'
      GROUP BY d.FY_QUARTER_NUMBER_STRING
      ORDER BY d.FY_QUARTER_NUMBER_STRING;
{% endset %}
{{ return(yaml_content) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.cr_project.test_fact_sow_amount_re.macro_sql:
{% test fact_sow_amount_reconciles_to_overall_value(model,column_name, parm1) %}

with 
    opportunity as (
        select 
            opportunity_bk,
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            deal_value
        from 
            {{ ref('dim_opportunity')}}
    ),
    daily_amount as (
        select 
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            sum(daily_amount) as sum_daily_amount
        from
            {{ ref('fact_sow_amount')}}
        WHERE
			effective_to = '2900-12-30 23:59:59.000'
        group by
            dim_opportunity_sid
    ),
    sow_values as (
        select
            opportunity.opportunity_bk,
            opportunity.dim_opportunity_sid,
            opportunity.deal_value,
            daily_amount.sum_daily_amount,
            abs(opportunity.deal_value - daily_amount.sum_daily_amount) as diff
        from
            opportunity
            join
                daily_amount
                on 
                    opportunity.dim_opportunity_sid = daily_amount.dim_opportunity_sid
    ),
    errors as (
        SELECT
            opportunity_bk,
            deal_value,
            sum_daily_amount,
            diff
        FROM 
            sow_values
        WHERE diff > 5
    )
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    errors

{% endtest %}

macro.dbt_artifacts.migrate_from_v0_to_v.name: migrate_from_v0_to_v1
macro.dbt_artifacts.migrate_from_v0_to_v.macro_sql:
{%- macro migrate_from_v0_to_v1(old_database, old_schema, new_database, new_schema) -%}

    {% set migrate_model_executions %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.model_executions (
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            "schema",
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            model_materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            model_schema,
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.fct_dbt__model_executions
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating model_executions", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_model_executions }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_tests %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.tests (
            command_invocation_id,
            depends_on_nodes,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            tags,
            test_path,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            depends_on_nodes,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            [],
            test_path,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__tests
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating tests", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_tests }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_test_executions %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.test_executions (
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            failures,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            null,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.fct_dbt__test_executions
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating test_executions", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_test_executions }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_models %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.models (
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            "database",
            depends_on_nodes,
            materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            path,
            "schema",
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            model_database,
            depends_on_nodes,
            model_materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            model_path,
            model_schema,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__models
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating models", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_models }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_seeds %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.seeds (
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            "database",
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            path,
            "schema",
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            seed_database,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            seed_path,
            seed_schema,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__seeds
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating seeds", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_seeds }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_seed_executions %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.seed_executions (
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            "schema",
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            'seed',
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            seed_schema,
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.fct_dbt__seed_executions
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating seed_executions", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_seed_executions }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_exposures %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.exposures (
            command_invocation_id,
            depends_on_nodes,
            description,
            maturity,
            name,
            node_id,
            owner,
            package_name,
            path,
            type,
            url,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            array_agg(output_feeds), {#- Here we un-flatten the transformation originally done -#}
            null,
            any_value(maturity) as maturity,
            name,
            node_id,
            null, {#- v0 is a string, v1 is a variant -#}
            any_value(package_name) as package_name,
            null,
            any_value(type) as type,
            null,
            any_value(artifact_generated_at) as artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__exposures
        group by command_invocation_id, node_id, name, artifact_generated_at
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating exposures", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_exposures }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_snapshots %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.snapshots (
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            "database",
            depends_on_nodes,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            path,
            "schema",
            strategy,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            checksum,
            command_invocation_id,
            snapshot_database,
            depends_on_nodes,
            name,
            node_id,
            package_name,
            snapshot_path,
            snapshot_schema,
            null,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__snapshots
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating snapshots", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_snapshots }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_snapshot_executions %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.snapshot_executions (
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            materialization,
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            "schema",
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            compile_started_at,
            'snapshot',
            name,
            node_id,
            query_completed_at,
            rows_affected,
            snapshot_schema,
            status,
            thread_id,
            total_node_runtime,
            was_full_refresh,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.fct_dbt__snapshot_executions
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating snapshot_executions", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_snapshot_executions }} {%- endcall -%}

    {% set migrate_sources %}
        insert into {{new_database}}.{{new_schema}}.sources (
            command_invocation_id,
            "database",
            freshness,
            identifier,
            loaded_at_field,
            loader,
            name,
            node_id,
            "schema",
            source_name,
            run_started_at
        )
        select
            command_invocation_id,
            node_database,
            parse_json('[{"error_after":{"count":null,"period":null},"filter":null,"warn_after":{"count":null,"period":null}}]'),
            name,
            null,
            source_loader,
            name,
            node_id,
            source_schema,
            source_name,
            artifact_generated_at
        from {{old_database}}.{{old_schema}}.dim_dbt__sources
    {% endset %}

    {{ log("Migrating sources", info=True) }}
    {%- call statement(auto_begin=True) -%} {{ migrate_sources }} {%- endcall -%}

    {{ log("Migration complete. You can now safely delete any data from before 1.0.0", info=True) }}
{%- endmacro -%}
